data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Senior Director, Visa Global Processor Partnerships, is responsible for executing business development strategies through partnership to grow our business and drive innovation adoption with processor partners located in Visa’s CEMEA Region (Central Europe, Middle East, and Africa). These clients are third party issuer processors (TPP\\’s).
   

  

 This person will work with CEMEA Processing Head in CEMEA region and provide operational support, strategic analysis, sales analysis and technical expertise. The result of these efforts will be increasing strategic value to the client, identifying new uses cases, and delivering Visa innovation across the ecosystem including processing (Issuer), program management, BIN sponsorship and core solutions.
   

  

 The Senior Director will also directly develop the portfolio of issuer processors and processing resellers in the CEMEA region.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, its players, and payment technologies. The Senior Director is required to say abreast of global payment trends and technologies that may affect client strategies.
   

  

 This position is full\-time and located in Dubai.
   

  

 As the Senior Director for Global Processor Partnerships, you will:
   

  

* Head the development and execution of all related sales activities with all Issuer processor in CEMEA region
* Work with product and processing teams to identify and prioritize the implementation of Visa solutions (tokenization, push payments, installments, digital issuance, risk and dispute solutions) for TPP integration and distribution.
* Identify and eliminate friction points that limit our ability to innovate and drive brand outcomes
* Oversee the development and management of the reporting of CEMEA Processing Partnership sales plans, including relevant metrics. Review KPI’s regularly with Processing Head to identify variances and work with the RPS team to address them.
* The person will be directly responsible for all issuer processor relationships and business development activities:
* Deliver on specific and aggressive processor account plans focused on Visa processing products and services, including traditional products, emerging digital solutions, white\-labeled services, and/or open platform extensions to processors
* Identify strategic opportunities through a strong understanding of clients’ businesses, including payment processing strategies aligned with Visa’s overall strategy
* Build and deepen relationships/partnerships with processor executives
* Prepare proposals, RFP’s, and negotiate contractual relationships with various internal and external stakeholders
* Participate on relevant cross\-functional teams (internal / external) that include representation from Product, Technology, Corporate Strategy, Digital Innovation, Operations, Marketing, Risk and Market Research groups


 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

****Qualifications****
* Strong knowledge of issuer processing, trends, and dynamics including ability to technically assess and engage with processors, fintech clients, neo\-banks, and all related technology players
* Strong knowledge of the CEMEA TPP landscape and the comparative position of regional ecosystem enablers
* 12\-15 years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8\-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6\+ years of work experience with a PhD
* 10 years Pre\-Sales or business development experience with related TPP sales and relationship management experience in the payments industry; issuer/acquirer processing experience/functional processing understanding is critical.
* Demonstrated track record of providing guidance and influence across multiple levels within a client organization, including senior executive management
* Background in planning, managing and closing complex sales efforts
* Background with Processing products and Platforms and its nuances
* Ability to implement strategic initiatives, including market sales plans, policies, and operational decisions
* Proven technical/operational project management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to establish effective relationships with all levels, including senior management
* Excellent strategic thinking and analytic skills and a proven track record of creating solutions that increase revenue
* Ability to manage \& grow internal and external resources and cross\-functional relationships
* Proven ability negotiating business agreements and ability to enhance existing and develop new business partnerships

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.


**What We Offer You**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding
* Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

*Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*

*Dubai is a vibrant, cosmopolitan city known for its modern architecture, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural heritage. data.jd_text:
Our client is an agency with over a decade of experience delivering world\-class brand events, runway shows, product launches and immersive experiences for the world's most prestigious fashion, beauty and lifestyle houses across the Middle East and beyond.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an exceptional
 **Events / Project Director** 
 to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-profile productions — someone who brings both creative sensibility and operational precision, and who understands what it means to work at the luxury standard.
 



**The Role** 




 Reporting to senior leadership, you will own the full lifecycle of multiple simultaneous projects — from brief and concept through to flawless on\-site execution. You will be the central point of contact for clients, creative partners and suppliers, and the person ultimately accountable for delivery.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Lead the production of luxury events including runway shows, brand activations, VIP experiences, product launches, store openings and private client events across the UAE and regionally
* Manage client relationships at a senior level, acting as the primary day\-to\-day contact from brief to debrief
* Build, lead and motivate project teams — internal staff, freelancers and specialist suppliers — across creative, technical, logistics and on\-site functions
* Own project budgets from AED hundreds of thousands to multi\-million dirham productions, ensuring financial rigour without compromising on quality
* Drive timelines, critical paths and risk management across concurrent projects
* Collaborate closely with creative directors and designers to ensure production brings the vision to life with precision
* Negotiate and manage supplier contracts, ensuring relationships that serve both quality and commercial outcomes
* Travel regionally as required for site visits, recces and event delivery
* Mentor and develop junior producers and coordinators within the team



**What We're Looking For** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury event production, with a strong portfolio spanning fashion, beauty, jewellery, hospitality or lifestyle brands
* Proven track record of directing large\-scale, complex productions end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced agency environment
* Deep understanding of what luxury means in execution — the details, the pace, the client expectations
* Strong commercial acumen with experience owning and managing significant budgets
* Excellent relationship management skills — calm, confident and authoritative with senior clients
* Experience working within the Middle East market; UAE experience strongly preferred
* Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus
* Willingness to work non\-standard hours around event schedules

**Job Description**
**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term client relationships and actively expand the client network.
* Identify and secure growth opportunities, initiating and supporting new project development.
* Support Project Managers and project teams, proactively resolving escalated issues and ensuring smooth project delivery.


**Your profile**
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of turnkey projects (scenic, fit\-out, AVL) such as museums, visitor experience centers, EXPO pavilions, and other permanent or semi\-permanent installations within the entertainment and cultural sector.
* Degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Audiovisual Engineering, or a related field is highly desirable.
* Solid technical understanding of Audio, Video, Lighting systems, and control technologies, with experience in large\-scale installations (preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and control large\-scale project budgets.
* Strong industry network within the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.
* Flexible and adaptable, with willingness to work according to project and industry requirements.

* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About Jumeirah F\&B** 




 At Jumeirah, dining is curated as a collection of exceptional destinations, where each signature restaurant offers a distinct expression of culinary artistry and refined luxury. Across Dubai, guests are invited to experience a world of rare flavours, immersive atmospheres, and thoughtfully crafted moments, where global cuisines are reimagined with precision and creativity. Defined by intuitive, personalised service and a deep attention to detail, Jumeirah’s F\&B experience transcends dining, creating a sense of occasion that is both distinctive and unforgettable.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 An exciting opportunity has arisen for an
 **Executive Director of F\&B Marketing** 
 to join
 **Jumeirah** 
 .
 



 The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 



  




* Shape and lead the vision and commercial trajectory of Jumeirah’s Signature restaurant portfolio, shaping how the destination is experienced, desired and chosen within Dubai’s evolving luxury dining landscape
* Translate bold brand ambition into sustained commercial success, driving meaningful growth in covers, guest acquisition, average spend and long\-term revenue performance
* Take full ownership of marketing investment and strategic direction, ensuring every initiative not only inspires the market, but delivers measurable impact on demand and booking behaviour
* Orchestrate a seamless commercial ecosystem, uniting Marketing, Revenue, Sales \& Events and Client Development into one high\-performing engine that consistently converts interest into visits
* Lead the launch and evolution of concepts with intent and precision, ensuring each moment in market creates lasting relevance, energy and demand across the portfolio
* Build and inspire a function that thrives on creativity, pace and accountability, setting new benchmarks for what luxury F\&B marketing delivers in both brand and performance



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 



  




* 12–15 years’ experience in luxury hospitality, lifestyle or premium F\&B environments
* Minimum 5\+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing multi\-outlet portfolios (8\+ venues or equivalent scale)
* Proven track record driving demand, covers and revenue through integrated marketing and commercial strategy

 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.

data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About this role:**
 We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
   

  

 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat


**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
   

  

**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
   

  

**By 12 months** 
 : You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**You must have**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data


**Bonus If You Have**
* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams


**This role is for you if...**
* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought


**This role is NOT for you if...**
* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices


**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
 Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
   

  

**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
   

  

**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

 Egis is building its data centre capability across the UAE and wider MESA region. We are seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of that emerging practice \- setting standards, leading major bids, and acting as our senior technical authority on mission\-critical work. Reporting to the Regional Director \- MEP, this is a leadership role with real scope to shape a practice from the ground up, backed by the reach and resources of a global consultancy.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Provide technical leadership and sign\-off authority across all data centre projects in the region
* Define and maintain MEP/ELV design standards and delivery frameworks for mission\-critical work

* Build and mentor a specialist data centre team within a 400\+ strong MEP/ELV practice
* Engage with clients, hyperscalers, EPCs, and authorities at Director level
* Drive innovation across BIM, parametric design, and AI\-assisted workflows

**Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of MEP engineering experience with a significant portion in data centre or mission\-critical environments
* Demonstrable experience at Technical Director, Associate Director, or equivalent level
* Deep expertise across data centre MEP/ELV systems: HV/LV, generators, UPS, precision cooling, EPMS, DCIM, and ICT infrastructure
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute, TIA\-942, and EN 50600 requirements
* Strong commercial awareness across fee negotiation, scope definition, and risk management
* Degree\-qualified with Chartered Engineer status (CEng or regional equivalent) required

**Additional Information**
* 400\+ strong, award\-winning MEP/ELV team across UAE, KSA, India, Jordan, and Egypt
* Live and growing pipeline of hyperscale and mission\-critical opportunities across the region
* Platform to build a specialist data centre practice from the ground up
* Backed by the depth and reach of a global consultancy
* Competitive Director\-level package and UAE benefits

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose Summary**
 Provides an efficient, accurate and timely Contracts and Purchasing Service for internal clients according to University policies and procedures. Focuses on vendor management. Ensures that each purchase is value for money and cost effective.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 GENERAL PURCHASING
   

  

* Purchases a variety of goods and services for both Campuses from local and international sources in line with the University By\-Laws.
* Materials procured range from: computers (hardware, software, consumables, accessories), audio video equipment, office equipment, office and classroom furniture, lab equipment, printing materials, stationery, text books, periodicals, vehicles, building materials and renovation services, rental of equipment/vehicles and maintaining the University Insurance Policies (Public Liability, Fire, Burglary and Vehicular), for both campuses.
* Interprets purchase requests, investigates supply sources and negotiates best terms and conditions in line with user specifications.
* Scrutinizes specifications carefully to ensure that they are generic in nature during enquiry preparation stage, and to advise or obtain clarification from end user when such anomalies appear.
* Solicits quotations in line with the purchasing method approved by the Director/line manager. Scrutinizes vendor quotations and prepares bid summaries as required. Makes recommendations where possible.
* Vets and benchmarks prices obtained through referring to historical data, web published prices, and/or checking with end users to compare budgeted and estimated costs with actual prices.
* Expedites orders to ensure that goods and services are delivered within contractual deadlines and ensures that end users are kept advised of delivery situation at all times.
* Liaises with vendors regarding discrepancies and damage reports to ensure correct replacement of materials in accordance with order specifications.
* Issues amendments in case of increase/decrease of quantities and cancellation of orders and ensures accuracy of data at all times.
* Ensures through liaison with end users that vendor invoices routed for payment approval, are not held up without reason.
* When requested by line manager, must be able to produce and place on record the complete history of a specific purchase, for presentation or audit purposes.
* Answers vendor and client queries as required.


 TENDERS
   

  

* Prepares vendor tender documents complete with technical specifications, conditions, bill of quantities, date for opening envelopes, tender validity, terms of payment and guarantee, in line with the Director’s/line manager’s instructions.
* Monitors closing dates for tenders and ensures that tender opening sessions are held on the day of closing.
* Receives tender documents and prepares appropriate record in preparation of the tender opening session.
* Passes on all tenders with appropriate record to the tender opening committee.
* Forwards technical documents/catalogues to appointed Technical Committee for technical evaluation. Addresses clarifications arising from technical queries by evaluation teams.
* On receipt of technical evaluation from end user, opens Commercial envelopes and prepares the Bid Summary.
* On the advice of the Director/ line manager, prepares orders/fax of intent.
* Prepares blanket orders according to standards, procedures and University By\-Laws.
* Collects Performance Bonds and Bank Guarantees and maintains their security through the Finance Department. Returns bonds to unsuccessful vendors as required.
* Monitors contractual delivery and completion deadlines and liaises with Contracts Specialist for any delays in contract delivery.


**Other**
* Must be fully conversant with, and able to prepare and issue requests for quotations on the Tejari.com business to business exchange.
* Must be fully conversant with the Purchasing module of the Banner System and be able to process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in line with adopted procedures.
* Maintains confidentiality of purchasing information and does not disseminate information to any Party, unless authorized by the Director/line manager.
* Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of all procedures in the By\-Laws and the University’s purchasing terms and conditions.
* Must be conversant with the Storekeeper’s functions to fill in duties when required to do so.
* Identify, mitigate and escalate procurement risks to enable the organization to meet its obligations and maximize business opportunities
* Maintain and update procurement records and generate reports on procurement and contract activity to meet organizational compliance requirements and provide access to procurement information
* Performs other related duties as assigned and needed.


 DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE/COMPLEXITY OF ENVIRONMENT
   

  

* Works independently to deal with different clients while maintaining confidentiality and a professional manner. Coordinates and directs a variety of purchasing requests, tenders, queries and correspondence. Mainly works to meet deadlines and must be able to function under time constraints.


 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS/IMPACT OF INTERACTIONS
   

  

* Works closely with the Director/line manager, C\&P, members in the Department and other departments, particularly Finance to ensure that the complete procurement cycle is completed effectively, through payment of invoices to vendors.
* Must communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external clients.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Must possess a Minimum of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and 2 years relevant professional experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Experience working in a similar role in a government or higher education institution will be highly preferred.
   

  

**Other Requirements**
* Excellent computer skills required.
* Knowledge of purchasing procedures is preferred.
* Arabic/ English bilingual an asset.


 COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Communication \-Able to share information in an effective \& collaborative manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Customer \& Service Focused \- Demonstrates a spirit of service excellence
* Results \& Action Orientation \- Demonstrates initiative to generate improvements and foster positive outcomes.
* Builds Effective Interpersonal Relationships \- Demonstrates interpersonal effectiveness in the workplace.
* Knowledge \& Technical Competency \- Demonstrates proficiency in technical and job knowledge aspects of the position to achieve high level of performance. Able and willing to learn.

 t.

The Head of Client Team is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing client relationships, managing cross\-functional project execution, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality work across all client\-facing projects. Reporting directly to the Arab Nation Director, this role requires a strategic thinker with strong leadership, project management, and communication skills. The Head of Client Team builds a culture of ownership, trust, and collaboration, ensuring clarity of purpose and excellence in execution across every project. This role also acts as the key connection point between clients and internal departments, playing a vital part in planning, financial tracking, and quality control.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Client Leadership \& Relationship Management
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new clients, overseeing onboarding and assigning appropriate project leads
* Provide strategic and creative input on client projects, ensuring alignment with objectives and brand direction
* Review and approve all client\-facing materials and deliverables before external submission
* Foster strong, long\-term client relationships built on trust, communication, and successful outcomes
* Team Management \& Leadership
* Lead, guide, and develop a team of 6 client service professionals
* Conduct weekly team meetings to align on priorities, solve challenges, and ensure accountability
* Actively promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance team culture
* Champion professional development by mentoring and identifying growth opportunities for team members
* Project Oversight Oversee of 15\+ projects across:
* Long\-term and short\-term social media management
* Campaigns management
* Video production Ensure all projects are progressing smoothly by:
* Reviewing regular progress reports from project leads
* Monitoring timelines, budgets, and key performance indicators(KPIs)
* Identifying potential issues and supporting teams in resolving them
* Ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with client expectations across all deliverables
* Strategic Planning \& Operational Management
* Develop and maintain the annual Client Team Capacity Plan, ensuring realistic project loads and balanced proposal intake
* Design and document detailed workflows, team responsibilities, communication protocols, and escalation steps
* Analyze team capacity to adjust workload, reallocate resources, or identify needs for external support
* Drive continuous improvement across operations and client service delivery
* Cross\-Departmental Coordination
* Lead structured weekly coordination meetings with production, content, finance, and procurement teams
* Align on timelines, deliverables, and shared goals
* Solve cross\-functional challenges and ensure efficient collaboration between departments
* Act as a bridge between client needs and internal capabilities

* Review the financial aspects of each project, including invoicing, payments, and budget tracking
* Make sure all project costs match the client agreement and are handled on time
* Work closely with the finance team to check estimates, approve invoices, and manage reports
* Monitor if project leads are handling financial tasks correctly and following the process

* Recommend and support team expansion when needed

**Requirements**
* Experience in client services, project management, or a similar leadership role
* Proven experience leading a team and managing cross\-functional projects
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
* Financial literacy and experience managing project budgets
* Familiarity with project management tools and performance tracking systems
* Experience in strategic planning, content or creative project oversight is a strong advantage
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven, client\-focused environment

Ignite School is expanding with the opening of a new purpose\-built
 **Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus** 
 located adjacent to our existing campus in Dubai. The new campus is currently under construction and is scheduled to open for the
 **2027/28 academic year** 
 .
 



 The appointed
 **School Director / Principal** 
 will join Ignite School during the
 **2026/27 academic year** 
 and will play a key leadership role in preparing the new campus for a successful opening. Working closely with the
 **Board of Trustees, KHDA, and the existing school leadership team** 
 , the Director will ensure that all regulatory, operational, staffing, and educational requirements are completed in line with approved standards and timelines.
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity for an experienced and visionary educational leader to help establish the culture, systems, policies, and learning environment of a new early years and elementary campus from its inception.
 



 The new
 **820\-seat campus** 
 has been designed to provide a modern, student\-centered learning environment that supports inquiry, collaboration, creativity, and early childhood development. Facilities will include dedicated learning spaces, specialist teaching areas, a parent and staff café, and extensive outdoor play and exploration areas.
 



**Role Overview** 




**The School Director / Principal will be responsible for the overall strategic direction, leadership, management, and efficient operation of the new campus. The role includes ensuring KHDA compliance, leading operational readiness, supporting student recruitment and enrolment growth, overseeing staff planning and recruitment, and ensuring a smooth transition for students, families, and staff into the new facility.** 




**As the KHDA\-nominated Principal, the Director will serve as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, compliance matters, inspections, and regulatory visits. The Director will also be ultimately accountable for the campus’s health, safety, wellbeing, standards, performance, and continuous improvement.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**New Campus Development and Opening Readiness** 



* Lead the planning and preparation required for the successful opening of the new Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus.
* Work closely with the Board of Trustees and KHDA to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.
* Develop, adapt, and implement campus policies, procedures, systems, and operational readiness plans.
* Support the transition of staff, students, and families to the new campus.
* Oversee student recruitment, admissions planning, and enrolment growth for the new campus.
* Ensure the campus is fully prepared across academic, operational, staffing, compliance, facilities, and parent communication areas.



**Strategic Leadership and School Management** 



* Lead the implementation of the school’s mission, vision, and approved education plan.
* Provide clear strategic direction and ensure effective organizational management.
* Monitor school performance through key performance indicators and improvement targets.
* Ensure high standards in teaching, learning, student wellbeing, safeguarding, and operational delivery.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and culturally respectful school environment.
* Maintain a strong focus on Emirati culture, Arabic language, Islamic values, and UAE national priorities.



**KHDA Compliance and Regulatory Accountability** 



* Serve as the KHDA\-nominated Principal on the school’s Educational Services Permit.
* Act as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, inspections, visits, and compliance matters.
* Ensure all school records are accurate, updated, and available to KHDA when required.
* Ensure full compliance with KHDA, UAE regulatory requirements, safeguarding standards, health and safety expectations, and internal school policies.
* Oversee the implementation of policies related to admissions, health and safety, inclusion, wellbeing, safeguarding, curriculum, assessment, teaching, complaints, and student support.



**Teaching, Learning, and Student Outcomes** 



* Ensure high\-quality teaching, learning, and educational provision across the campus.
* Monitor student progress, achievement, wellbeing, and engagement.
* Ensure the needs of all students are met, including Emirati students, students of determination, high\-performing students, and students requiring additional support.
* Lead the continuous improvement of curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and learning outcomes.
* Support the development of a child\-centered learning environment that promotes inquiry, creativity, collaboration, and early childhood development.



**Parent Partnership and Community Engagement** 



* Build strong, positive relationships with parents and the wider school community.
* Promote effective communication between the Director’s office, families, staff, and stakeholders.
* Lead parent engagement initiatives, meetings, events, and service recovery discussions when required.
* Use parent feedback, surveys, and evaluation data to support timely school improvement.
* Strengthen parent satisfaction, loyalty, and student re\-registration.



**Operational and Financial Management** 



* Ensure effective use of school resources to support educational and operational priorities.
* Manage campus operations in line with approved budgets and school expectations.
* Support enrolment targets, re\-registration, fee collection, and efficient resource allocation.
* Monitor facilities, health and safety, and service quality to ensure a safe and high\-quality school environment.
* Identify operational challenges and allocate resources effectively to support school success.



**Staffing, Performance, and Human Resources** 



* Lead the recruitment and appointment of suitably qualified staff in line with KHDA and school requirements.
* Support the formation and development of the campus leadership and administrative teams.
* Oversee staff performance management, probation reviews, annual evaluations, and professional development.
* Promote staff retention, accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
* Manage staff\-related matters in line with school HR policies, including performance concerns, disciplinary matters, grievances, and allegations against staff.



**School Improvement and Accreditation** 



* Lead the development and implementation of the School Improvement Plan.
* Support DSIB inspection readiness and continuous progress toward strong inspection outcomes.
* Contribute to maintaining and strengthening NEASC accreditation standards.
* Use data, feedback, and evaluation outcomes to drive measurable improvement.
* Ensure improvement actions are followed up, monitored, and completed to a high standard.



**Candidate Profile** 



* **The ideal candidate will be an experienced educational leader with a strong background in early years and elementary education, school start\-up or campus development, American curriculum leadership, and UAE regulatory compliance. The candidate should demonstrate strong strategic thinking, excellent communication, sound judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to build trust with staff, parents, students, regulators, and the wider school community.**

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director Digital UI/UX is accountable for defining and leading Kerzner International’s digital experience strategy and design execution across the global brand portfolio, including Atlantis, One\&Only, SIRO, and Rare Finds.
   

  

 The role owns the end\-to\-end experience, vision, design quality, and user ‑centred execution across all digital products and channels, ensuring guest journeys are intuitive, premium, accessible, and conversion effective. Acting as the design authority for digital experience, the Director‑ Digital UI/UX establishes experience principles, design systems, and optimisation practices that consistently translate brand intent into high q‑uality digital interactions.
   

  

 The Director Digital UI/UX works in close partnership with the Director Digital Products, who owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, and platform decisions. Together, the roles ensure digital products deliver measurable business results while maintaining a differentiated, guest centric experience aligned with Kerzner’s luxury positioning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Experience Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and own Kerzner’s global digital experience strategy across web, mobile, booking, and supporting platforms
* Translate brand, guest, and business objectives into clear experience principles and design direction
* Ensure consistency of experience across brands while allowing for brand specific expression where required
* Act as the senior design authority for all guest facing digital experience


**Guest Journey Design \& Optimisation**
* Lead the design of end\-to\-end guest journeys across discovery, inspiration, booking, and post booking touchpoints
* Drive continuous experience optimisation to improve usability, engagement, and conversion
* Partner with the Director Digital Products to align experience led optimisation initiatives with commercial priorities and targets
* Balance ‑guest centric design with performance, scalability, and delivery constraints


**Design Systems, Standards \& Governance**
* Establish, evolve, and govern Kerzner’s digital design systems, component libraries, and experience standards
* Define UX/UI best practices, accessibility standards, and quality benchmarks
* Ensure consistent application of design standards across internal teams, agencies, and partners
* Review and approve experience and design decisions for major initiatives and releases
* Maintain hands‑on proficiency in industry‑standard tools (e.g. Figma) and emerging AI‑powered design capabilities


**User Research, Insights \& Experimentation**
* Own user research practices, including qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, and journey validation
* Interpret analytics, experimentation results, and guest feedback to identify experience improvement opportunities
* Translate insights into actionable design recommendations and priorities
* Collaborate with Product, Data, and Marketing teams to ensure insights inform roadmap and optimisation decisions


**Cross Functional Collaboration \& Delivery**
* Partner closely with Digital Products, Technology, Marketing, Brand, and Content teams
* Support agile and product oriented delivery models with embedded design practices
* Provide clear executive level communication on experience vision, priorities, and outcomes
* Engage and manage external design agencies and partners to deliver against experience standards


**Ways of Working**
 The Director Digital UI/UX and Director Digital Products operate as peer leaders within the Digital \& Technology leadership team. The Director Digital UI/UX owns experience strategy, design quality, and user ‑centred execution, while the Director Digital Products owns commercial outcomes, prioritisation, platform strategy, and technical decision making. Decisions impacting both domains are made collaboratively, with escalation to the Chief Digital \& Information Officer where required‑.
   

  

**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**

 Reporting to the Senior Client D
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


 ABOUT YOU
   

  

**Essential**
* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.
* Motion graphics and video editing skills: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, tourism boards, rights holders or sports federations in the region.
* Bilingual creative capability in English and Arabic.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

 The Associate Creative Director will lead multidisciplinary internal and external creative teams across graphic design, content creation, video production, social media, motion graphics, photography, CGI and campaign production.

 Mandatory UAE Real Estate Experience

 Strategic Collaboration
 


* Report directly to the Marketing Director.

 Quality Control and Brand Governance

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.
