Job description:
   

  


**About the Company:** 




 At Almosafer Travel \& Tourism Co, we’re not just part of the travel industry, we’re helping shape its future.
   

 As Saudi Arabia’s leading travel company, we serve millions across every segment of the travel and tourism ecosystem.
   

 Rooted in our name “Almosafer,” meaning the traveler, we strive to make every journey seamless, personal, and purposeful. Our diverse platforms and services are built to deliver enriching experiences that reflect the spirit of Saudi Arabia and the wider region.
   

 We’re united by a bold vision:
   

 To be the undisputed leader in travel services, fostering lasting connections and setting new benchmarks for excellence in the Kingdom and beyond.
   

 Our team across Saudi Arabia and the wider region blends deep cultural understanding with forward\-thinking innovation, shaping a new standard for travel in the region. 
 



**About the Role:** 




 The Product Manager is responsible for gathering and challenging business requirements and translating them into solutions with the guidance of our Head of Salesforce Product. The Product Manager has experience implementing Salesforce.com functionality and acts as a knowledgeable liaison between business stakeholders and developers.
 



 The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, implementation teams, integration/development teams, and quality assurance teams to ensure successful delivery and continuous enhancement of the Salesforce ecosystem.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Act as a consultant to the business with advanced knowledge of Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Salesforce Community
* Translate business requirements into user stories and well\-architected solutions that leverage Salesforce platforms and products
* Provide detailed level\-of\-effort estimates and articulate benefits and risks of proposed solutions
* Collaborate with and manage Salesforce Developers to define appropriate technical strategies and designs
* Stay up to date with new Salesforce products, releases, and technical capabilities
* Work closely with cross\-product teams to understand the impact of broader initiatives on Salesforce
* Lead daily stand\-ups and manage backlog grooming processes
* Coordinate with business and technical teams to ensure smooth project and enhancement delivery



**Profile Requirements:** 



* B.S. Degree in Computing or a related field with at least 5 years of overall professional experience, including a minimum of 3 years in Product Management and 2 years as a Salesforce Developer and/or Software Engineer
* Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator and Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder (Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant certification is desirable)
* Domain experience in IT / CRM with strong knowledge of Salesforce Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Experience Cloud environments
* Hands\-on experience with declarative functionality, Flow, Triggers, APEX, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, migration tools, and SOQL
* Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and Confluence, including large call center implementations
* Travel and tourism industry experience is desirable
* Proficiency in Arabic and English with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast\-paced environment



**Being You @ Almosafer:** 




 At Almosafer, our teams work with purpose, clarity, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way. Whether you're building platforms, supporting travelers, or shaping strategy, your work connects to something bigger. Across functions and locations, we value accountability, trust, and collaboration \- and we create the structure and space for you to contribute meaningfully from day one.

 A purpose\-led workplace where your ideas can create real impact
   

 Ongoing learning and development to help you grow with intention

 A community built on trust, curiosity, and shared momentum
 



 No matter where your journey started, at Almosafer, you will find space to grow, connect, and contribute meaningfully.

**Some brands sell products.** 




**We help shape decisions that change lives.** 




  





 Every day, 24 million measurements are taken on a seca device somewhere in the world. In hospitals in Tokyo, clinics in São Paulo, GP practices in Hamburg. The data that flows from those moments helps doctors, nurses, and specialists make decisions that matter — sometimes routine, sometimes life\-changing.
 



  





 We are not a tech startup. We are not a challenger brand reinventing ourselves every 18 months. We are a 185\-year\-old family business with the discipline of a world market leader, the curiosity of engineers who still love what they build, and a marketing team that thinks in campaigns — not content calendars.
 



  





**And we have one open seat.** 




  





**What this role actually is:** 




 As
 **Senior Creative \- Campaign Art Direction (m/f/d)** 
 you will be a central creative force behind our international campaigns across Medical and Fitness — two demanding, visually distinct segments, both requiring the kind of strategic depth and executional craft that only comes from real agency experience.
 



  





 This is not a production role. This is not a "make it beautiful" role. This is a thinking\-and\-making role, where concept and execution are inseparable and where the quality of the idea is just as accountable as the quality of the layout.
 



  





 You will join an international team at our
 **office in Dubai, UAE** 
 and work closely with our Global Marketing and Creative teams at our headquarters in Hamburg, Germany inside our inhouse creative studio — structured and resourced like an agency, embedded in one of the most internationally active Health Tech companies in the world. Working closely with and under the creative direction of our Head of Creative, you will develop campaigns from brief to delivery across digital\-first formats: landing pages, paid social, display, video, and interactive platforms. You bring the craft, the concept discipline, and the drive to see an idea through without needing someone to push it. What you do not bring is the ego of someone who needs to run the room.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for:** 



* Developing campaign concepts from strategic brief to final execution — under creative direction, but with genuine ownership of your work
* Executing the visual language of integrated campaigns across digital, social, and where relevant, linear formats including trade fair and print
* Creating and art directing digital experiences: landing pages, UI concepts, interactive campaign formats
* Maintaining creative quality across global rollouts adapted for up to 16 international markets and languages
* Collaborating directly with Marketing and Product Management, with the professionalism to represent the creative work clearly and confidently



  





**What you bring:** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in advertising or brand communications, with a substantial part of that in an agency environment
* A portfolio that demonstrates both conceptual strength and executional mastery — campaigns you conceived and built, not just approved
* Deep expertise in Figma and Adobe CC; you work in the tools, not around them
* Proven experience in digital campaign production: landing pages, paid social, motion graphics
* Experience in Medical, Health Tech, or Fitness marketing is a significant advantage — you understand that this audience demands precision, not flair for its own sake
* Fluent English, written and spoken — our campaigns are global, our briefs are often in English, and your presentations will be too
* Linear advertising experience (TV, OOH, AV) is a bonus, not a barrier
* The maturity to thrive within a defined creative direction while still bringing your own strong point of view to every brief



  





**What we offer:** 




 We will skip the part about the coffee and the fruit basket. You have read that before. What we can offer that most can not: the creative ambition of an agency environment, inside a company with genuine market authority, a 185\-year legacy that is not a limitation but a creative challenge, and a product portfolio that genuinely affects human health. Your work will reach healthcare professionals across 17 international branches and over 175,000 customers worldwide.
 



  





 Join a workplace that connects, motivates, and moves forward together – where your work has real impact.
 



  





**About seca** 




 Founded in Hamburg in 1840, seca has grown from a precision scale workshop into a global Health Tech brand. For over 185 years, we have built devices and software solutions that help healthcare professionals make better decisions — in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centers, and fitness facilities around the world. As a family\-owned company now in its fourth generation, we operate 17 international branches.
 



  





**Ready to shape international campaigns for a global Health Tech brand?** 
 Apply today and help define how seca communicates across Medical, Fitness, and digital platforms. We look forward to receiving your complete application.
 



  





**Please note that only applications including a relevant portfolio or selected work samples will be considered.**

Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
 As Head of IOCC, you will:
   

  

* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. We welcome applicants who bring practical experience, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to operational excellence. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* An inclusive workplace with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* The chance to build and lead a new, and growing, high\-impact operational function at the heart of our business.
* A role that offers visibility and cross functional problem solving \- at SolitAir you'll be able to see the difference you make to the success of our business


 If you are an experienced operational leader with strong problem solving skills, flexibility and excellent English communication, we encourage you to apply and help shape SolitAir’s operational future.

This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong demonstrated background in airborne connectivity solutions and a proven ability to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction. The connectivity portfolio encompasses satellite communications for cabin Wi\-Fi, on\-board networks, cockpit datalink and safety services. The Sales Manager will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building client relationships, creating winning propositions, and achieving sales targets. This role requires a blend of commercial insight, industry and technical expertise, and sales acumen.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and Implement Sales Plans: Support the creation and execution of a robust sales strategy to grow the connectivity solutions business in the Business Aviation and Head of State markets.
* Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including aircraft operators, management companies, channel partners, and governmental agencies. Proactively manage key accounts to ensure flawless delivery of service and client satisfaction.
* Consultative Sales: Apply deep knowledge of connectivity solutions to create compelling solutions and proposals to meet and exceed client requirements.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Work closely with customer account and support teams and regional leadership to help develop and execute growth strategies. Provide market intelligence and client feedback to offering management teams to inform product strategies.
* Negotiation and Closing: Support negotiation efforts with clients to secure win\-win solutions.
* Sales Forecasting and Reporting: Grow and manage sales pipeline within the CRM system.
* Brand Ambassador: Represent Honeywell Aerospace at industry events, conferences, and networking functions to enhance brand visibility and promote Honeywell connectivity solutions.


**Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of airborne connectivity solutions, including satellite communications services and hardware.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in connectivity solutions in the aviation market.
* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets and driving business growth.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.


 Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret market trends and customer requirements are essential for success in this role.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

data.jd_text:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**Opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model**
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.


**Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team**
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.


**Lead Global People Relations Services**
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.


**Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams**
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.


**Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations**
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.


**Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery**
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.


**Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement**
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.


**Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change**
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 , you will help build a more connected, scalable, and future\-ready support model, improving service quality, strengthening self\-service, and ensuring complex cases are handled with care and consistency. Your work will directly influence employee experience, manager effectiveness, and how the People function continues to evolve as Agoda grows globally.
   

  

 \#PeopleServices \#HRSharedServices \#EmployeeRelations \#Bangkok \#Singapore \#Bengaluru \#Hyderabad \#NewDelhi \#Gurugram \#Noida \#Mumbai \#Pune \#Chennai \#Jakarta \#Manila \#KualaLumpur \#HoChiMinhCity \#Hanoi \#HongKong \#Taipei \#Seoul \#Dubai \#Istanbul
   

  

 Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





  





**About Madinat Jumeirah** 




 Set along a two\-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. Guests can also enjoy the serene waterfront setting of Jumeirah Mina Al Salam and the secluded Arabian houses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. Together, they form a one\-of\-a\-kind destination rooted in Arabian luxury hospitality. The resort features over 20 curated restaurants and lounges, the traditional Souk Madinat Jumeirah, dedicated kids' clubs and some of the region’s most versatile event and conference spaces.

 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a
 **Head Chef** 
 to

 from

* Lead all kitchen operations, ensuring the consistent delivery of exceptional food quality, creativity, and presentation standards.

* Oversee food purchasing, inventory management, cost control, and waste reduction strategies to maximize operational efficiency and profitability.

 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.

**Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Management**

* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend value creation initiatives

* Lead all stages of the investment process, including opportunity assessment, financial analysis, valuation, structuring, due diligence, negotiations, and execution

* Support business transformation, operational optimisation, growth strategies, and capital planning across investments

* Mentor and develop junior investment professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with finance, legal, risk, treasury, and business leadership teams


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure all investments adhere to internal governance frameworks, investment policies, and risk management standards
* Present investment opportunities and portfolio updates to governance committees and senior leadership
* Maintain high standards of compliance, transparency, and fiduciary responsibility

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Real Estate, or related discipline
* 12\-18\+ years of relevant experience in private equity, sovereign wealth funds, investment management, principal investing, infrastructure, real estate, private credit, or investment banking
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions from origination through execution
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, and investment analysis capabilities
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to investment committees and boards
* Excellent commercial judgement and strategic thinking skills
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing teams
* Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, CAIA, or other relevant postgraduate qualification
* Experience investing across real estate, infrastructure, private equity, credit, or alternative investments
* Exposure to large\-scale investment platforms and institutional capital deployment
* Experience operating in international markets with strong understanding of regional investment dynamics
* Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities in a fast\-paced environment


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to shape investment strategy and drive value creation across multiple asset classes within a rapidly growing platform. data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Product Management (Pricing \& Assurance)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard’s Transfer Solutions team in EEMEA is driving at scale innovation and growth to meet today’s demands for simple, certain, and secure international and domestic payments by individuals and businesses of all sizes. Mastercard Move is a portfolio of integrated assets and capabilities designed to service key verticals, customer segments and multiple payment flows. Through simple connectivity means, we enable partners the ability to reach a variety of endpoints—account, card, mobile wallet, cards and cash out locations —nearly anywhere in the world.
   

  

 The organization is looking for a Director, Product Management (Pricing \& Assurance), Mastercard Move as part of the EEMEA Product Management Team for Cross Border Payments, to work with customers, who are primarily large Financial Institutions, Fin Techs, Bureau De Changes / Exchange Houses or Government Clearing Schemes to further the strategic and commercial agenda of Mastercard in the region focused on Cross Border Payments, which includes Low Value B2B / Commercial Payments, P2P Remittances and Purpose\-based payments like Bill Payments, Tuition Payments, Utility, Social Security etc.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is aware of the Cross\-Border Payments landscape and is aware of the intricate dynamics of how money moves between Institutions and Borders, being familiar with the role Correspondent and Bilateral Banking arrangements play in the setup, the evolving nature of SWIFT (and its evolution to ISO messaging standards), existing Settlement \& Funding mediums, helping to identify the gaps and solutionize areas where Mastercard’s own and partner led solutions can add value.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* This is a Pricing and Assurance role at its heart where you will work with Product Sales teams / Account Managers to ensure we are able to provide best commercial value to our customers alongside safeguarding long\-term financial interests for the company.
* Often, you would work with customers directly to help them formulate the right value story / financial model to ensure the product is able to provide the best Value Proposition to our clients and their customers.
* Prepare / facilitate complex business cases within Mastercard at a customer / deal / portfolio level to ensure the right investments / financial support / prioritization is done for opportunities worth the merit.
* Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle for the business, and partner with Finance colleagues upstream and Sales colleagues downstream to ensure we can project and hit the business numbers.
* Formulate and track underlying business driver and enabler metrics on weekly / fortnightly / monthly level with cross\-functional teams – including delivery timelines, growth rates etc. as relevant.
* Executive presentation outlining business direction and facilitation of QBR / MBR with senior leaders and often with strategic clients. Partner for strategy refresh cycles to evaluate what’s working v/s not.
* Act as PMO for key internal work\-streams which affects revenue realization – like Network health and breadth, FX constructs, Deal Incentive structures etc.


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Understands cross\-border payments at its’ core and the lever(s) that influence the commercial health of the product and the business at large.
* Understanding of financial and reporting principles of key metrices that influence business development.
* Be able to work horizontally in a highly matrixed organization with overlapping ownership and influence. Be able to get the work done through influence, reasoning rather than authority.
* Very strong with Excel and PowerPoint as that would effectively be 70% of your work – pricing, governance, reporting.
* Strong communicator and have the temperament to be able to lead client facing conversations independently.
* If you have done a pricing role in the past in the industry – it’s a plus. Product FP\&A candidates may also be fit with extension.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

This role requires a deep understanding of fund administration services, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to provide tailored solutions to meet clients’ fund administration needs. The role holder shall primarily interface between external parties (investment managers, auditors, bankers, brokers, legal counsels etc.) to understand their requirements and internal parties (different production units globally) to ensure compliance, ensuring all the deliverables are accurate, on time and of high quality.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
 Client Relationship Management:
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships.
* Conduct regular meetings with clients to understand their fund administration needs, regulatory requirements, and reporting preferences.
* Ensure clients are informed about the full range of fund administration services available and provide expert guidance on best practices.
* Interpret the data and answer queries that might arise from the Investment Manager or investors regarding the financial statements of a fund and in particular its portfolio investments, fee calculations and NAV per share.
* Attending client meetings and provide technical support to the sales team.


**Service Delivery And Quality Assurance**
* Collaborate with internal fund accounting teams to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of services to clients.
* Service existing funds and their managers to ensure timely and excellent delivery of services as agreed with each manager.
* Review NAV packages and ensure they are error free before being sent to the investment manager and investors.
* Communicate regularly and effectively with the Fund Accounting team in India/ Mauritius who are responsible for all accounting and investor services.
* Give administrative support to Fund Services team and Fund Relationship Manager, including arranging payments, keeping filing updated, scanning and faxing.
* Constant monitoring of shareholder services to ensure up to date processing of subscription and redemptions, with timely completion of KYC/AML checks.


**Time Recording**
* Accurately record chargeable time and value of service using Maconomy, ensure effective monitoring of transactions, handle pricing, invoicing and collection of outstanding fees for the portfolio of clients.
* Monitor own productivity and chargeability on weekly basis and review productivity and performance against targets. to ensure that individual financial targets and client communication KPIs are met.
* Follow a disciplined approach to submitting timesheets for client work and meet the weekly and monthly time/chargeability targets


**Other Duties**
* Undertake the role of director, trustee, nominee, manager, partner, secretary, authorized signatory or any related position in internal entities or client entities of Amicorp Group, where necessary and required by the Management.
* Undertake such other duties, as may from time to time, be required by the Management or/ and Group Human Resources.


**Qualifications, Skills, And Experience**
* Relevant Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics or Business Administration. CPA/ CA/ CAIA qualified or part qualified (preferred but not a must)
* At least 5\-8 years’ work experience in fund administration, with a good understanding of the daily operations of fund administrator including compliance, NAV computation and transfer agency function.
* Knowledge of regional financial markets and different financial products.
* Solid understanding of ledger entries, accounting for different transactions in the investments industry and their impact on financial statements.
* Hands on experience in the field of Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Fund Structuring and/or Fund Directorships. Good understanding of local market Fund regulations. Knowledge of PFX Paxus would be an advantage.
* Experience in Private Equity fund structuring, waterfall distribution, carried interest calculation are highly
* appreciated. Basic understanding on offshore jurisdiction fund structures as well as industry relevant regulations including FATCA, CRS, BEPS, GAAR, ESR.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, preferable in regional languages. Exceptional client facing skills. Well\-developed spoken and written communication skills and the ability to tailor style to relevant audiences, and successfully liaise with people at different levels. Excellent English language fluency; additional languages preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, solution driven, highly organized and detail\-orientated with good decision making and time management skills. Independent, hands\-on and takes accountability to deliver solutions and results.
* Ability to adapt and work in a smaller, dynamic local team environment with tight deadlines; along with being part of a bigger matrix organization. Proven team player skills, with ambition to excel in the role and grow into fund origination and structuring.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 HKA is a leading global consultancy in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, expert witness and litigation support. We anticipate, investigate and resolve complex challenges by harnessing world\-leading multi\-disciplinary expertise and experience.
   

  

 As trusted independent consultants, experts and advisors, we deliver solutions amid uncertainty, dispute and overrun, and provide the insights that make the best possible outcomes a reality for public and private sector clients worldwide. Our experts have testified across the globe on many of the largest quantum, delay, engineering and commercial damages matters.
   

  

**At HKA, You Can Expect**
* A genuinely collaborative culture where we invest in growing our FACD practice and your career together.
* A pivotal role in shaping the future of our FACD offering across EMEA and globally.
* The opportunity to leverage HKA’s reputation as one of the world’s most respected expert witness firms to accelerate the growth of your valuation and financial damages portfolio.
* Access to an outstanding expert platform, cutting\-edge methodologies and a global network of specialists.


**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior Manager / Associate Director in our Forensic Accounting \& Commercial Damages (FACD) team, you’ll be part of a high‑performing global practice known for delivering market‑leading expert advisory services.
   

  

 This is an exciting stage for our Middle East team, offering the chance to step into a visible leadership role, working alongside Partners recognised internationally for their expertise in contentious valuations and forensic accounting.
   

  

**You will play a key role in the success and continued expansion of our International FACD practice by:**
* Leading substantial workstreams on complex disputes and managing smaller engagements end‑to‑end.
* Owning key client relationships and ensuring exceptional delivery.
* Guiding, coaching and developing junior colleagues as part of a growing team.
* Drafting articulate, concise and compelling expert reports, supporting our experts on high‑value disputes.
* Conducting and reviewing sophisticated financial, accounting and economic analyses with a high degree of technical rigour.
* Performing business valuations, using relevant tools and methodologies to generate robust and defensible opinions.
* Communicating insights and deliverables clearly to Partners, clients and legal teams.
* Driving business development, including attending industry events, identifying opportunities and contributing to thought leadership.
* Leading internal development initiatives, from training to process improvement.


**Skills \& Experience**
 We’re looking for an ambitious, analytical and commercially sharp Senior Manager / Associate Director who brings:
   

  

* A graduate or postgraduate degree in accounting, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Qualified accountant status (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with experience in a recognised professional services environment specifically within forensics.
* Demonstrated experience in forensic accounting, contentious valuations, and dispute\-related engagements.
* Strong problem‑solving skills, exceptional analytical capability and meticulous attention to detail.
* The ability to think strategically and operate confidently in ambiguous or evolving situations.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly.
* A reputation as a trusted colleague and collaborative team member.
* Fluency in English is essential; additional language capability is advantageous but not required.


**ED\&I At HKA**
 HKA has a thriving ED\&I committee working hard to provide an inclusive and welcoming environment for a truly diverse set of employees. We are committed as a business on the continued improvement of our Equality, Diversity and Inclusion strategy, please visit our careers page for further information or feel free to ask our recruitment team for further information.
   

  

 All HKA employment decisions are firstly made on merit and shall be made without regard to age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, marriage, and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation, or any other basis in compliance with local legislation.
   

  

**Stay Alert: Protect Yourself from Phishing Scams**
 Please be aware that HKA only publishes official job postings on our website (Join Us \| HKA) and on verified job boards. We will never ask for sensitive personal information during the job application process. If you have any doubts, we recommend you visit our website to verify job listings before applying. If you would like more confirmation, please feel free to email us at enquiries@hka.com to check the authenticity of a job posting.
   

  

 HKA is one of the world’s leading consultancy of choice for multi\-disciplinary expert and specialist services in risk mitigation and dispute resolution within the capital projects and infrastructure sector.
   

  

 We also have experience advising clients on the economic impact of commercial and investment treaty disputes and in forensic accounting matters.
   

  

 As trusted independent consultants, experts and advisors, we deliver solutions amid uncertainty, dispute and overrun, and provide the insights that make the best possible outcomes a reality for public and private sector clients worldwide.

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://wca\-global.com Job Function: Audit \& Taxation Company Industry/

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 280\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




 Dubai Holding is currently seeking a
 **Senior Manager – Digital Services** 
 , reporting to the Director – Infrastructure Operations. The role holder is responsible for the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of the organisation's web platform ecosystem, spanning a portfolio of 100\+ digital properties, enterprise API integrations, cloud\-hosted web applications, and internal business automation solutions.
 



 The role holds end\-to\-end ownership of web platform operations across the organisation, orchestrating the combined capabilities of internal development teams, strategic third\-party vendors, and emerging technologies to deliver secure, performant, and accessible digital experiences at scale.
 



 A core contributor to the group\-wide digital strategy and technology roadmap, the role plays an integral role in shaping and executing the direction of the organization's web platform function — ensuring all solutions and initiatives are grounded in sound architectural principles, aligned to security, compliance, and governance requirements, and structured to deliver tangible business value.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 



* Define and own the organization's web platform architecture strategy, ensuring all digital solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to business objectives.
* Act as the senior solution architect across all web development initiatives, bridging the gap between business requirements and technical delivery.
* Oversee the full lifecycle management of web platform components, from planning, procurement, and development through to deployment and decommissioning, operating within defined budgets, risk appetites, and compliance frameworks.
* Take executive ownership of the availability, stability, performance, and compliance of all web platform services — including 100\+ Web flow\-managed digital properties, Azure\-hosted web applications, and associated integration services — ensuring they remain fit for purpose and aligned with agreed service levels.
* Drive a proactive performance culture across the function, ensuring continuous monitoring, technical SEO and AEO optimization, analytics configuration, and resolution of platform issues before they impact the business or end\-user experience.
* Provide 24/7 senior operational oversight for the digital portfolio, serving as the escalation point for critical incidents and urgent business requests, and applying deep technical expertise to rapidly coordinate resolution and minimize business impact.
* Serve as the organization's senior authority on web security and data protection, owning compliance with information security standards, proactively monitoring for vulnerabilities, and driving the implementation of security improvements across the entire digital portfolio.
* Champion rigorous standards for web accessibility, ensuring all digital properties meet WCAG compliance requirements, and embedding accessibility principles from design inception through to production delivery.
* Own and govern the organization's cookies consent framework across 100\+ digital properties, overseeing technical implementation, monitoring ongoing compliance, and managing the strategic relationship with the cookies consent solution vendor.
* Ensure all web platform solutions adhere to data protection, information security, and accessibility standards — embedding required principles and design patterns from inception through to delivery.
* Design, build, and steward enterprise\-grade API integrations — including Salesforce and custom microservices — applying best practices in REST API design, security, and documentation to ensure robust, maintainable, and scalable integration architecture.
* Lead the evaluation, onboarding, and governance of SaaS solutions and enterprise platforms — including enterprise contract and license management, user access management, and vendor relationships — ensuring all tools are adopted effectively and deliver measurable value.
* Manage and evolve the organization's internal Power Platform capability, overseeing the design and delivery of automation flows and applications.
* Develop and manage the web platform and digital operations budget in excess of $1M, balancing cost efficiency with operational excellence, and continuously identifying opportunities for financial optimization without compromising service quality or delivery capability.
* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with business, commercial, and marketing stakeholders, acting as a trusted technical consultant on new digital initiatives and providing expert guidance on platform capabilities, constraints, and opportunities.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary digital team — comprising web developers, operations manager, and microservices developer — setting clear direction, providing meaningful performance feedback, and creating pathways for professional growth and career development.
* Drive upskilling and continuous development initiatives within the team in line with the capability requirements and service priorities of the function.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ownership within the team, encouraging experimentation with emerging technologies while maintaining delivery discipline and quality standards.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 Proven experience in enterprise web platform management, digital operations, or a closely related discipline, with a minimum of 8 years in a leadership role overseeing multi\-stakeholder digital environments.
 



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Master's degree in computer science
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* UX Management certification



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Front\-end and full\-stack development proficiency: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, Astro, PHP
* Microsoft Azure platform knowledge, with hands\-on experience in App Services, deployment pipelines, and Azure DevOps
* REST API design, development, and validation; experience building secure, production\-grade integrations
* Low\-code/no\-code automation platforms: Power Apps, Power Automate, Zapier, Xano
* Database design and SQL; data engineering fundamentals
* Web Accessibility Standards (WCAG) and UX best practices
* Technical on\-site SEO and AEO strategy and implementation
* Analytics and tracking: Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, custom data layer configuration
* Webflow platform administration and development at enterprise scale
* DNS, networking fundamentals, and information security principles
* Version control and CI/CD workflows (Git)
* Figma and design\-to\-development collaboration



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to high volumes of applications only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

**About Jumeirah** 




  





 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About the Job** 




  





 As part of our continued commitment to operational excellence and leadership succession across our portfolio, we are curating a talent pool of high\-potential and experienced hospitality leaders for a
 **Director of Finance** 
 opportunity to join
 **Jumeirah in Dubai** 
 , supporting both current and future needs. The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 



  




* Provide strategic financial leadership across the property, driving sustainable profitability, informed decision\-making, and long\-term business performance through effective financial planning, analysis, and forecasting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, influencing commercial and operational strategies through insightful financial guidance, performance analysis, and risk assessment.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual budget, forecasts, and capital plans, ensuring financial objectives are achieved while identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, returns, and value creation.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with owners, asset managers, auditors, corporate teams, and external stakeholders, representing the property's financial interests with credibility, professionalism, and influence.
* Ensure the highest standards of financial governance, compliance, internal controls, and risk management, safeguarding the integrity of financial operations and maintaining adherence to regulatory and company requirements.
* Lead, develop, and inspire a high\-performing Finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership while enhancing financial acumen across the wider organisation.



  





**About You** 




  





 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 


* Minimum 10 years of progressive finance leadership experience within internationally recognised luxury hospitality brands, with a strong understanding of complex hotel operations and commercial drivers.
* Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CIMA, CMA or equivalent) combined with the ability to translate financial data into strategic business insights and informed decision\-making.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior leadership teams, owners, and key stakeholders, influencing business performance through commercial acumen, sound judgement, and strategic thinking.
* An inspirational and hands\-on leader with demonstrated success in developing high\-performing teams, fostering collaboration, and building a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Previous experience within the GCC hospitality market is highly desirable, with a strong understanding of the region’s business environment, regulatory landscape, and market dynamics.



  





**About the Benefits** 




  





 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.
 



 Benefits include:
 


* Supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to Learning \& Development programmes and clear career pathways
* Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network
* Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide
* Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave entitlement
* Incentive programmes aligned with leadership performance
* Competitive tax\-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED)

 Retail Performance \& Commercial Leadership

* Establish and manage annual budgets, forecasts, and business plans.
* Ensure achievement of revenue, margin, and operational targets.



  





 Client Experience \& Brand Excellence
 


* Champion an exceptional luxury client experience across all touchpoints.

* Drive clienteling initiatives and CRM strategies to increase loyalty, retention, and lifetime value.

 This is a rare opportunity to join one of Asia's most established and respected residential rehabilitation groups — an organisation with a 10 year\+ heritage of transforming lives, treating thousands of clients from more than 20 countries, and building a reputation as the premium destination of choice for individuals seeking discreet, high\-quality addiction and mental health care.
 



  





 The business operates a flagship 30\-bed residential site and has recently expanded into Europe with a specialist 10\-bed programme — reflecting an ambitious international growth agenda under the leadership of a highly experienced CEO with a background in world\-class medical tourism operations.
 



  





 The model is built on medical tourism: clients travel from the UK, Australia, the Middle East, Singapore, the Netherlands, the US, and Canada to access a programme that delivers demonstrably better outcomes at approximately 40% of the cost of comparable UK providers — with private rooms, comprehensive clinical programming, and a destination environment that facilitates genuine recovery.
 



  





 The business is profitable, growing, and entering its most commercially ambitious phase to date. This hire is central to that next chapter.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Director of Marketing and Business Development is a senior, commercially critical appointment reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the full growth engine of the business — leading both the Sales (Admissions \& Strategic Partnerships) and Marketing (Digital, Content \& Brand) functions, and driving high\-quality client acquisition across the group's international markets.
 



  





 You will inherit a talented, technically capable four\-person marketing team based in Thailand, supported by a specialist external SEO agency. Your role is to lead, elevate, and execute — bringing strategic rigour, digital expertise, and commercial edge to a business that has earned its reputation through exceptional clinical outcomes and now needs to accelerate its market presence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales \& Revenue Growth** 



* Own and deliver revenue performance across all markets and service lines
* Lead the Admissions function to ensure a seamless, high\-conversion client journey

* Represent the organisation at international forums and industry events

* Lead the internal marketing team and external agency partners
* Drive performance across online search, AI\-driven discovery platforms, SEO, and digital channels

* Improve visibility on AI discovery platforms where the business is currently underrepresented

**Brand \& Thought Leadership** 



* Elevate the organisation's reputation as a recognised authority in addiction treatment and mental health care
