data.jd_text:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Meet our Professional Services Team!**
 Successful implementation and value from the Sprinklr platform starts with us. As customers advance their strategies and invest more in social media as a business driver, we’re looking for experienced project managers to help realise those ambitions. As a member of our team, you’ll support our customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Sprinklr is looking for a Global Program Manager to lead one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client in Doha. You will be responsible and accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of the program, working with a retained team dedicated to the client.
   

  

 This is an on\-site role based in Doha, Qatar, supporting a public\-sector client. The successful candidate will be expected to work from the client site on a full\-time basis.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client, coordinating the retained team and controlling program scope, change control processes, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Partner with consulting teams, leaders and other internal departments or regional teams to coordinate and drive delivery.
* Ensure that overall program is effective, whilst running individual projects according to schedule and keeping within budget.
* Develop relationships and ensure the appropriate participation of key client \& internal stakeholders and executives.
* Develop, build, and maintain durable and trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Develop knowledge of the Sprinklr platform components and module\-synergies \- so as to be able to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and high\-level solutions.
* Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed effectively.
* Manage client service expectations and briefs and drive successful, measurable outcomes for the client.
* Set the tone for the team and strive for quality and excellence in all aspects of delivery.
* Provide weekly project status and burn reports to the relevant project stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of the current industry environment that shapes opportunities for client solutions.


**Experience:**
* Experience managing enterprise SaaS programs for government, public\-sector, or highly regulated clients.
* Ability to operate directly from the client site, manage daily executive interactions, and build trusted relationships with senior public\-sector stakeholders.
* Extensive client management experience, including close collaboration with business owners and executive\-level clients.
* Experienced managing projects in IT, SaaS, Social, or Software environment.
* Experienced working with multi\-geo, multicultural delivery teams.
* Prior experience delivering programs in Qatar or the wider GCC region is a strong advantage.
* Experienced working on large scale project management in leading multi\-organizational initiatives, and driving team accountability to achieve goals.
* Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk, develop detailed work plans and specifications, perform resource allocations and run team meetings.
* Demonstrated ability to assume a leadership role in managing project, departmental and enterprise risks related to projects, systems and business analysis.
* Strong influencing skills and negotiation / mediation skills.
* Ability to motivate and focus people resources where there is no direct reporting relationship.
* Proven mentoring, supervisory, and team\-building skills.
* Ability to resolve problems with keen instincts and organizational experience.
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycles, web technologies, web development processes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Fluency in English is mandatory; Arabic is highly desirable to support effective local stakeholder engagement.
* Experience in Agile project management a plus.
* Certification of any kind for Project Management (Prince2, PMP, SCRUM etc.)


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Job Purpose** 




 QCRI is seeking an Executive Director to provide strategic and visionary leadership in high\-priority areas of computer science and artificial intelligence. Preference will be given to candidates with a clear, uninterrupted, and active research track record in computing\-related disciplines, along with a strong awareness of emerging developments in AI. The Executive Director is responsible for advancing QCRI’s research excellence, innovation, and global impact. This includes setting the institute’s strategic research direction, fostering a dynamic and collaborative research environment, securing diverse funding sources, and strengthening partnerships with leading universities, research centers, industry partners, and global technology companies. The Executive Director oversees the institute’s budget, recruitment, and mentorship activities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 The Executive Director should articulate a clear and compelling vision that leverages emerging global trends while capitalizing on strategic opportunities in Qatar and the broader region. The Executive Director is expected to:
 



 • Develop and implement a research strategy aligned with HBKU, Qatar Foundation, national priorities, and global scientific opportunities.
 



 • Provide scientific and organizational leadership to advance QCRI’s mission and research excellence.
 



 • Lead interdisciplinary, mission\-driven research programs that address national and global challenges.
 



 • Build strategic partnerships with industry, government, academia, and leading global technology organizations.
 



 • Strengthen QCRI’s international reputation through scientific leadership, collaborations, and major research initiatives.
 



 • Drive research impact through publications, technologies, platforms, products, and contributions to policy and practice.
 



 • Expand external funding and strategic investments to support research growth and sustainability.
 



 • Promote and lead collaboration across HBKU, Qatar Foundation, and external partners to maximize research and innovation impact.
 



 • Recruit, develop, and retain outstanding researchers and promote a high\-performance research culture.
 



 • Mentor and support the development of early\-career researchers and emerging scientific leaders, with particular emphasis on building local research talent.
 



  





**Minimum Knowledge, Skills \& Experience** 



* Ph.D. in Computer Science or a closely related field, with an internationally recognized record of research excellence and scientific impact.
* Extensive progressive experience in research and technology development and in overseeing large\-scale programs and teams.
* Demonstrated experience in leading and managing research, innovation, and technology development projects.
* Proven ability to build, lead, mentor, and motivate high\-performing multidisciplinary research teams.
* Strong understanding of national and international frameworks, policies, and ethical considerations related to computing, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Wood is accepting expressions of interest for a Project Director (Offshore) to join our team in Qatar. This role create delivery excellence across assigned project/program/portfolio of projects, provide certainty and confidence to the customer/project sponsor, and robust control of project scope, schedule, cost and risk.
   

  

 Specifies and directs the implementation and completion of one or more major projects or programs, including responsibility for managing safety, scope, cost, schedule and risk, and ensuring appropriate reporting and governance is in place. Responsible for delivery of project(s)/program(s)/portfolio to agreed scope, specifications, schedule and budget, for managing change and customer relationships. Delivers project(s)/program(s)/portfolio which often involves a high level of complexity and risk with multiple workstreams and high financial risk. Oversight of multiple project managers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* P \& L responsibility with associated commercial and financial accountability including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination and attainment, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing and cash collection
* Contributes to and reviews the project proposal and plan to establish timeframe, procedures for accomplishing the project, resource requirements, and allotment of available resources to various phases of the project. Ensures adherence to corporate policy and best practice, and sets project evaluation parameters.
* Negotiates changes to project scope with the customer. Follows Change Management process to identify and approve modifications to scope, cost, schedule and quality
* Pursues and develop opportunities for innovation, such as digitalisation and technology use, work share and high value engineering centres, to bring value to Wood and customer
* Approves project procedures and project execution plan including the scope of work, deliverables list, master schedule, budget, org charts, risk register etc
* Ensures competence of project team members to carry out assigned work
* Oversees proposals and call\-offs (may be single projects) within delegation of authority, ensuring compliance with contracting policy and standards of ethical conduct.
* Monitors adherence to schedule, cost and quality and proactively intervenes to avoid slippage
* Ensures that the required project management software systems are established for the project and the supporting training is completed
* Ensure the project assurance protocol and schedule are established
* Involved in establishing terms and conditions, and wider scope and larger size of projects may require more visibility in the community as well as activity in attracting project staff
* Responsible for the project HSSE leadership, ensures a program of initiatives and auditing schedule are established, and that HSSE and quality management issues are proactively addressed
* Drives good practices, including corporate initiatives, across projects and programs
* Resolves complex issues which are escalated by project team
* Participate in assurance activities and peer reviews
* The complexity, potential impact and political sensitivity of projects/programmes of this size (particularly in an international context), frequently require the project director to be involved in closing the deal, attracting specialized staff from outside the organization, and managing relationships with local officials and community groups as well as the customer and contractors, all based on their credibility and proven track record


**Qualifications**
* University degree (bachelors or masters) in Engineering
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Associate in Project Management (APM) or equivalent certification is preferred
* Typically requires more than 20 years of broad and extensive pertinent experience, including minimum 10 years project management experience, mastering their area and knowledgeable about impacts on other areas; of which substantial experience successfully managing major/complex international or remote location projects.
* Requires strong technical skill as relevant to the project scope(s)
* Good level of experience in the related field, industry, and locations of the work
* Has thorough knowledge of project success and benefits management
* Expert in stakeholder management with extensive experience in managing challenging stakeholders and able to coach and advise others in this area
* Thorough understanding of requirements management from creation to monitoring to verification of complex project requirements and their linkage to business benefits.
* Knowledge of work flow management, established policies for engineering ownership, globalization of projects and request for tender process
* Experienced in assembling and managing multi\-phase project budgets, including risk contingencies
* Expert Practitioner in Risk Management processes, well versed in how risks are transposed into cost, time and contingency estimates and forecasts
* Advanced knowledge of various forms of vendor contracts across many types of goods and services; able to create new appropriate contracting frameworks and negotiate to successful conclusion.
* Able to manage complex major project start\-up, produce and communicate the project execution plan
* Expert understanding of both explicit and implicit dependencies and able to explain these and build into recommendations
* Experience of implementing successful project performance improvement activities and techniques for recovering poor performance
* Knowledge of supplier categorisation and experienced in devising appropriate commercial acquisition strategies
* Understands the needs of information management requirements in the project phases (operation), internal (contractual, statutory) and asset (customer) documentation.
* Able to negotiate appropriate close\-out terms with all key stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively manage resources (personnel, equipment, materials etc)
* Sound practice and experience of commercial and technical risk management.
* Able to drive cash flow management as well as projection/forecast of cost at completion


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com
   

  

**Diversity Statement**
 We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for a Deputy Director – Food Operations to fully own the operational performance of our Food vertical.
   

  

 This is a standalone, high\-impact role focused on execution, optimization, and profitability. You will work directly with the COO to translate strategy into disciplined operational outcomes. Food is a high\-frequency, high\-pressure business — it demands precision, speed, and strong judgment under constant movement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the operational engine of the Food vertical: vendor performance, delivery efficiency, cost structures, contribution margins, and overall vertical performance health. Every operational lever that impacts reliability, scalability, and profitability will sit under your direct ownership.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a performance role.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Operational Strategy \& Execution
* Partner closely with the COO to define and execute the Food operations roadmap.
* Convert strategic priorities into measurable KPIs and execution plans.
* Ensure sustainable order growth while protecting contribution margins and operational stability.
* Drive operational readiness for expansions, new initiatives, and structural improvements across the vertical.
* Food Vertical Performance \& Unit Economics
* Own the core performance metrics of the Food vertical including fulfillment rate, SLA adherence, cancellation rate, delivery time, cost per order, rider productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Continuously optimize supply\-demand balance in dense operating environments.
* Refine incentive structures for riders and restaurant partners with a clear understanding of their economic impact.
* Work closely with Finance to model profitability scenarios and implement cost control initiatives.
* You should deeply understand how prep time affects dispatch logic, how batching impacts utilization, and how operational mechanics influence margin.
* Process Optimization \& Scalability
* Identify inefficiencies across the Food operational lifecycle and eliminate them through structured, data\-driven problem solving. Standardize SOPs and improve operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech to automate manual workflows and enhance dispatch, batching, and visibility tools.
* Lead root cause analysis for service failures and implement corrective action frameworks that prevent recurrence.
* Restaurant Operations \& Partner Success
* Monitor and improve restaurant operational metrics including prep time accuracy, acceptance rates, SLA compliance, and order quality.
* Work closely with Commercial to ensure operational feasibility during onboarding and scaling.
* Reduce friction between restaurants and logistics by introducing structured performance frameworks and clear accountability mechanisms.
* Analytics \& Performance Discipline
* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.
* Build and refine dashboards, reporting structures, and performance scorecards that directly influence operational decisions.
* Leverage demand forecasting, cohort analysis, and behavioural data to identify growth and efficiency levers. When metrics shift, you understand why — and you act decisively.

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist SVP/ VP to drive cultural change around Lean across QNB Group. The incumbent will be responsible for leading and managing the Group’s Lean and Six Sigma agenda under the Innovation department. Responsibility includes owning, leading and managing selected portfolio of Lean projects across QNB Group’s international network with minimal supervision.

**Who We Are:** 




  





 Técnicas Reunidas (TR) is a leading international engineering and construction company in the energy sector, with more than 65 years of experience and over 13,000 professionals worldwide. We have our headquarters in Madrid, offices in Bilbao and Cartagena, and engineering centers in India, Abu Dhabi, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Chile, among others, offering career opportunities in an international environment. Our commitment to people has been recognized with the Top Employer certification in Spain and India.
 



  





**Global Projects and the Energy of the Future** 
 :
 



  





 At TR, we develop projects in Oil \& Gas and Power, and we are advancing toward the energy of the future through hydrogen, clean fuels, and carbon capture projects, integrating digitalization, AI, and robotics. Our high level of professionalism and commitment drives continuous research to improve efficiency and sustainability, always in strict compliance with the law and aligned with the highest ethical standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Steel Structure Superintendent leads and coordinates the construction activities of a Steel Structure performed by Subcontractors, with the support of Construction Supervisors, generally assigned by area. He will act mainly at the Subcontractor's interface, leading him to perform his scope of work on budget, schedule and with the required quality and compliance of HSE standards.
 



 Steel Structure Superintendent maintains a proper interface with the rest of Disciplines, not only with the Construction ones but also with Engineering and Procurement to solve any matter affecting Steel Structure works at Site.
 



 Based on above points, Steel Structure Superintendent is the first responsible for the timely completion of the construction works, ensuring while Project is constructed in strict accordance with approved execution plan. Conflicts or revisions to this plan shall be immediately communicated to the Project team for mutual resolution.
 



  





**Main functions:** 




  




* Review the last revision of IFC drawings, Engineering Instructions and method of statements, along with Steel Structure schedule, to properly supervise the works at Site and ensure that construction activities are done on schedule, quality and cost.
* Arrange with the Subcontractor the corresponding weekly meetings to validate and consolidate the week ahead activities to be performed. The Steel Structure Superintendent shall keep always updated the weekly plan against the overall Project schedule with full knowledge about the current Workfront.
* Assist the Planning and Production Control Departments to update the current Steel Structure plan or to develop a new forecast plan revision.
* Check that the Steel Structure Supervisors are aware about the Subcontractor scope of work and that the daily targets are fixed according with Project schedule. The Steel Structure Superintendent shall distribute the workload between the Supervisors based on the weekly targets.
* Ensure that the daily production is evaluated by every Steel Structure Supervisor and it is daily loaded in the system. Demand the corresponding clarifications to the Supervisors to avoid discrepancies with Planning Department and ensure the reliability and readiness of the progress declared by the Subcontractor.
* Evaluate the Steel Structure Supervisor performance, enhancing their skills and abilities. Organize workflow and ensure that employees understand their duties or delegated tasks. Dismiss Steel Structure Supervisors who fail to meet expectations under justified arguments.
* Check with Steel Structure Supervisors that the adequate Subcontractor manpower is available for each task and the labour force allocated on the job is productively used.
* Steel Structure Supervisors will know the Steel Structure corporate tools and procedures, and he will use and apply them in the daily work. Report the manpower deployed at Site in a daily basis.
* Check in advance with Subcontractor that required tools and worksite access (scaffolding, roads, etc.) are available to perform the planned daily activities.
* Manage the material dispatched to the Subcontractor and ensure its efficient use. Identify proper methods of material handling and preservation to prevent damages or deterioration. Minimize as much as possible the site storages period.
* Provide on\-site coordination with Subcontractor, walk daily all work areas to monitor activities. Validate the FEWOs and contribute with the corresponding information to issue the reliable evidences.
* If applicable, verify and follow up the compliance and filling of the Work Time Sheets by the Steel Structure Supervisors, demanding full accuracy over the hours required to perform the activity.
* If applicable, validate and follow up the required Vendor assistance man\-hours to minimize them for the contractual ones. In no case, the Vendor technician will cover the function and responsibilities of Supervisors because of their negligence or lack of skill/knowledge.
* The Steel Structure Superintendent does not have authorization to be engaged in commercial agreements (subcontracts, change orders, work authorizations). However, he should provide the necessary support to Subcontract Department to identify the Subcontractor deficiencies and negligence of its functions. Ensure that Subcontractor is fully executing and complying with his contractual scope of work.
* Undertake actively the discussions, technical queries and site agreements with Engineering / Client to prevent common topics (accessibility, typical, etc.) suffered in previous Projects as to increase production and reduce reworks.
* Ensure that any red\-marked drawing provided by Subcontractor include all changes exactly as it was built. Implement and know the ITPs, and any other TR procedure and make them effective at Site.
* Steel Structure Superintendent shall follow up the site quality control programs to ensure quality completion of construction. He will promote mock\-up and toolbox with Subcontractor, Supervisors and Quality Inspectors before starting up a new construction activity to make sure everybody understands and is aligned with the applicable Project Specifications, Standards and Method of Statements.
* Prevent making goods by the corresponding checkpoints inspections conducted by the QC/Supervisors and demand to the Supervisor team his ownership on this issue.
* As a maximum responsible at Site in his Discipline, he shall keep clean and organize the unit/work area in compliance with HSE and good practices.
* He will be proactively involved in the HSE programs and campaigns to create a HSE culture in his Subcontractor and Supervisor team.
* Coordinate and focus the work towards the Mechanical Completion of the plant in line with the PMCs and the commissioning priorities, once agreed with the Construction Manager.
* Supervise the close out of the Steel Structure punches by Subcontractor during the handover stage.
* Encourage the Supervisors to collect and report the LL during the Project execution for him to load them in the corporate LL application.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil, Structural, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years of construction experience, including at least 7\-10 years in Steel Structure Supervision or Superintendent roles.
* Extensive experience in structural steel erection, fabrication, installation, alignment, and bolting activities.
* Experience on EPC projects within Oil \& Gas, LNG, Petrochemical, Power Plant, or Industrial Construction sectors.
* Experience supervising subcontractors, construction supervisors, and multidisciplinary site teams.
* Ability to coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Quality, Commissioning, and Client representatives.
* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work in multicultural environments and manage multiple priorities under tight project schedules.
* Fluent in English.

* Plan and manage airside phasing and work windows, including shift/night works where required, ensuring safe demarcation, temporary arrangements, and handback readiness.
* Coordinate airside execution interfaces (earthworks/pavements/drainage/duct banks/AGL interfaces) to avoid rework and to maintain a clear critical path for airside readiness.
* Ensure survey control, setting\-out and level/line control are established and maintained for airside geometry compliance (grades, levels, transitions) and that as\-built data is captured progressively.
* Review and interpret approved drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, and related technical documents, and ensure construction works are executed in accordance with the latest approved information.
* Review, comment on, and ensure implementation of method statements, inspection and test plans, work packs, permits, and short\-term execution plans before works commence.
* Plan and control site resource deployment, including labour, plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, access arrangements, and lifting requirements for each work front.
* Coordinate with Technical, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, Commercial, and Project Controls to ensure construction activities are properly supported and sequenced, while maintaining Construction accountability for execution decisions and site inputs.



  





**Procurement \& Contract Management** 




  




* Contribute to the preparation of technical specifications and scope of work.
* Support tendering processes, including contractor selection and bid evaluations.



  





**Construction Quantities, Plant \& Resource Accountability** 




  




* Remain accountable and responsible for defining, reviewing, and formally signing off the plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site execution resources required for the works.
* Review and verify material quantities, equipment requests, and site resource plans before submission to Procurement or other support functions.
* Monitor plant utilisation, availability, maintenance status, suitability, and replacement needs, and take corrective action where shortfalls may affect safety, quality, cost, or programme.
* Review and sign off measured quantities, quantity take\-offs, measurement sheets, and supporting site records before issue for progress measurement, valuation support, reporting, or third\-party use.



  





**Site Supervision \& Quality Assurance** 




  




* Supervise construction works to ensure compliance with design specifications, engineering standards, and quality requirements.
* Identify and resolve design, technical, and execution issues in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Conduct regular site inspections and enforce quality control procedures.
* Ensure airside pavement works (subgrade, capping, subbase/base, asphalt/concrete as applicable) comply with approved ITPs, testing frequencies, and acceptance criteria; drive timely corrective actions for non\-conformities.
* Coordinate with QA/QC and testing laboratories to ensure traceable test results, approvals, and release of work fronts prior to subsequent layers/activities.
* Coordinate AGL civil readiness (duct banks, pits, chambers, cable routes, bases) and support commissioning readiness activities by ensuring construction completion and close\-out of punch items affecting AGL installation/testing.
* Carry out constructability, interface, and field\-readiness reviews to confirm that works can be executed safely, efficiently, and in line with approved drawings and site conditions.
* Verify installed quantities, field measurements, and supporting site records before these are issued for progress measurement, valuation support, or reporting.
* Review subcontractor and supplier execution documentation, including shop drawings, method statements, lifting plans, temporary works submissions, and ITPs, and ensure comments are closed out before implementation.



  





**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 




  




* Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
* Enforce compliance with local regulations and international construction standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all contractors and site personnel. Implement airside\-specific safety controls including airside driving rules, access/escort protocols, exclusion zones, communications/briefings, and stringent FOD prevention, ensuring that all personnel and subcontractors comply with airside operational safety requirements.
* Ensure work areas are secured with compliant barricading/marking and that temporary conditions do not create hazards to aircraft operations.
* Ensure daily FOD walks/controls and strict housekeeping standards are implemented and recorded.
* Ensure that method statements, permits to work, lifting plans, and task\-specific risk assessments are reviewed and implemented before execution.



  





**Risk \& Issue Management** 




  




* Identify potential project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Proactively resolve construction challenges to avoid delays or cost overruns.
* Provide early warning on discrepancies in drawings, quantities, site conditions, plant or equipment performance, and subcontractor capability that may affect delivery.
* Provide early warning on airside operational constraints, access restrictions, interface clashes, and handback risks that may affect safety, programme, or readiness milestones; propose mitigation and recovery actions.



  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




  




* Perform any other related duties as assigned by management in support of project delivery. This includes formal construction review and sign\-off on relevant site execution matters where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of
 **7–10 years of experience** 
 in construction management, preferably in large\-scale infrastructure or airport projects.
* Proven experience managing contractors and complex construction sites.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airside works (runway/taxiway/apron/roads earthworks and pavements and/or airfield civil works) with strong understanding of airside execution constraints.
* Experience working in operational airfield environments or under strict access and permit\-to\-work controls is a strong advantage.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, materials, and project management principles.
* Familiarity with ICAO airfield requirements (geometry, safety areas, markings/signage/AGL interfaces) and airside compliance constraints is a strong advantage.
* Experience working in Africa, preferably in challenging or emerging markets.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, method statements, inspection and test plans, and related technical documentation.
* Practical experience in quantity verification, progress measurement, field productivity monitoring, and review/sign\-off of site execution records.
* Strong understanding of plant, equipment, machinery, temporary works, materials planning, and construction resource control.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Strong leadership and site management skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety
* Fluent in English is mandatory; professional working proficiency in French is strongly preferred.
* Strong technical ability in reading drawings, verifying quantities, reviewing method statements, and assessing construction resource requirements.
* Clear ownership mindset for plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site productivity.
* Strong discipline in permit\-to\-work compliance, shift handback readiness, and interface coordination in constrained operational environments.
* High standards of field leadership, subcontractor control, and delivery predictability under fast\-paced conditions.



  





**Work Environment** 




  




* Site\-based role in Kinshasa with regular presence on construction sites
* May require extended working hours depending on project needs
* Exposure to a dynamic, fast\-paced infrastructure development environment

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.

 The Planning Manager is responsible for the development, management, and control of integrated project schedules, including cost\- and resource\-loaded planning, across all project phases.
 



 The role ensures accurate schedule forecasting, progress measurement, and performance analysis through Primavera P6 and Earned Value Management (EVM). It provides critical insights into time, cost, and resource performance, enabling proactive decision\-making and successful project delivery.

* Prepare integrated planning and performance reports, including S\-curves, dashboards, and look\-ahead schedules.
* Develop and monitor resource plans and histograms, ensuring optimal utilization and productivity.
* Review and validate contractor schedules, ensuring alignment with project requirements and timelines.
* Assess risks, delay, and change impacts, performing what\-if and recovery schedule analysis.
* Ensure compliance with project controls standards, processes, and reporting frameworks, driving continuous improvement.

* 8–12 years of experience in project planning and scheduling.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
* Primavera P6 certification preferred.
* PMP or equivalent is an advantage.

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 30th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous la responsabilité du Conseil d'administration (CA) de l’Alliance Française (AF) de Manama, et sous l'autorité du conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC), vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement, du bon fonctionnement et du développement de l’Alliance ainsi que du suivi de l’ensemble des actions qui y sont menées, en conformité avec les lois locales. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la Mondialisation, le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances Françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'Alliance Française de Manama accueille 500 à 600 élèves différents par année. L'Alliance est propriétaire de ses locaux, toutefois le foncier demeure la propriété du Ministère bahreïnien des Finances. Elle possède 7 salles de classe équipées en TBI. L’ensemble du parc informatique a été renouvelé, avec connexion internet en fibre optique et 5G. L'AF assure aussi des cours hors de ses locaux (Écoles internationales, dont le Lycée français, Ministères, Universités, personnalités VIP) et cherche à développer les cours hors les murs. Et dispose d'un auditorium de 120 places. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes responsable des missions suivantes: Élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l'établissement ; Mise en place des priorités linguistiques et culturelles définies par l'Ambassade, par la Fondation Alliance française, sous l'autorité du CA de l’AF, de l'Ambassadeur et du COCAC ; Élaboration du budget de l'établissement, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi ; Etablissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays d'affectation ; Représentation de l'Alliance Française en justice et dans tous les actes de la vie civile ; Compte rendu des réalisations et du contexte au Conseiller culturel, à l'Ambassadeur, à la Fondation et à la Direction Générale de la Mondialisation (DGM) du Ministère de l'Europe et des affaires étrangères (MEAE).
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Master 2 ou niveau équivalent Expérience d’un milieu associatif et de sa gouvernance (relation CA) Compétences en communication et marketing Expérience avérée en management d’une équipe, direction d’un établissement Expérience de levée de fonds et/ou de mécénats Bonne connaissance du CECR, de la pédagogie par projet et de l’approche actionnelle La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

data.jd_text:
**The kind of PM we're looking for**
 You've got 2\-4 years under your belt at an independent pharma or healthcare agency, enough to know how MLR works, what a tight timeline actually means, and how to keep five things moving without losing the thread on any of them. You're not a coordinator looking to level up, and you're not a senior PM who needs to own the strategy. You're in that sweet spot where execution is your superpower and you genuinely love it.
   

  

 You thrive when the environment is lean, the team is direct, and no one's waiting on three layers of approval to make a call. If you've come from a large networked agency, this might feel different, in a good way, if you've been craving it.
   

  

**What you'll do**
* Plan and execute pharma marketing projects across cross\-functional teams, keeping everything moving from kickoff through delivery
* Build and own project timelines, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks before they become problems
* Coordinate internal teams across creative, account, strategy, and analytics, you're the connective tissue
* Run status meetings, kickoffs, and checkpoints that are tight, useful, and don't waste anyone's time
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and workflow trackers with obsessive consistency
* Monitor budget burn and flag scope shifts early, you catch things before they become conversations
* Keep projects inside established workflows and escalate when something's about to go sideways


**What This Role Is Not**
 This is not a budget ownership role. It's not scope negotiation or team management. And if your planning horizon is quarters rather than days, this won't be the right fit. This role is about execution, doing it well, doing it fast, and doing it with the kind of calm that steadies the people around you.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2\-4 years of project management or coordination experience inside a pharma or healthcare independent agency environment
* Hands\-on familiarity with Ziflow and Slack; comfort picking up new tools quickly
* The organizational instincts to track what others miss without being asked
* A communication style that keeps teams aligned, direct, clear, no noise
* A solutions\-first mindset: you don't just flag problems, you walk in with options
* Energy for execution, you're wired for the day\-to\-day, not the 30,000\-foot view


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* $91,000 to $110,000 USD
* Full medical and dental benefits
* 15 days vacation plus one additional day per year of service, unlimited flex time
* $500 home office stipend at time of hire
* Our hiring package is ever\-evolving to meet the needs of our team


**The environment**
 P10 is remote\-first, always has been. The team moves fast, the clients are direct, and the work is real. You'll report to our Project Director, and work inside a structure that's flat enough that your contributions are visible and your voice is heard.
   

  

 If you've been looking for a place where independent thinking is rewarded and nobody's waiting on a committee to make a call, this is it.
   

  

 Interested in working with us? Apply online today.
   

  

**Not an agency\***
 The layer\-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego\-driven dog\-and\-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn’t working, or could work better, change it. And that’s exactly what we did. We know that what we’re not makes us who we are. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.
   

  

 P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote\-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different \- join us.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Assystem is an international company with one mission: accelerate the energy transition around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia \& Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low\-carbon energy.
   

  

  

  

 We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.
   

  

  

  

 Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.
   

  

  

  

 To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* **Project Leadership:** 
 Lead and monitor multi\-disciplinary engineering design teams throughout the project lifecycle to ensure seamless delivery of comprehensive engineering packages.
* **Scope \& Schedule Management:** 
 Define project scope, develop detailed delivery schedules, and monitor progress against critical paths to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* **Financial Control:** 
 Manage project financial performance, including budgeting, cost estimation, forecasting, and tracking cash flow against milestones.
* **Stakeholder Relations:** 
 Act as the primary focal point for clients, subcontractors, and regulatory authorities, leading regular design reviews and managing change orders effectively.
* **Risk Mitigation:** 
 Identify technical and commercial risks early in the design cycle and execute proactive strategies to protect project timelines and margins.
* **HSEQ Compliance:** 
 Ensure all engineering designs and project delivery methods strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality guidelines.


**Qualifications**
* **Experience:** 
 A minimum of
 **5 years of dedicated experience** 
 in engineering project management or design management, preferably within an engineering consultancy, infrastructure, or complex energy sector environment.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related discipline) from an accredited university.
* **Professional Registrations:** 
 Mandatory membership/registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). A Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification is highly desirable.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong understanding of standard multi\-disciplinary engineering design workflows, technical documentation cycles, and modern digital engineering platforms (e.g., BIM or CAD systems).
* **Skills \& Competencies:** 
 Exceptional leadership, stakeholder negotiation, and conflict resolution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing diverse, multi\-cultural engineering teams.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is considered a significant asset.


**Additional Information**

 We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

 We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and oversee various energy sector projects, ensuring their successful delivery within scope, budget, and timeline. This role involves managing project teams, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation to achieve project objectives.

* Identify and manage project risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Manage project budgets, tracking expenditures, and ensuring financial targets are met.
* Oversee procurement processes for project materials and services.
* Conduct post\-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices for future projects.
* Prepare and present project reports, presentations, and documentation to senior management and clients.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**
* A bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering is required.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in project management, preferably within the energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6\).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and geographically dispersed team environment.

* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a frozen food manufacturer in Saudi Arabia to appoint an Operations Director (Head of Factory).
   

  

****Role Purpose****
 The Operations Director holds full strategic and operational accountability for the manufacturing facility. This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the plant's operational strategy, building a high\-performing organization, and delivering against ambitious targets for output, quality, cost, and safety.
   

  

 The successful candidate will set the operational agenda, modernize and scale the facility, and embed a culture of excellence that positions the plant as a benchmark in the frozen food sector.
   

  

****Strategic Leadership****
* Define and execute the operational strategy for the facility, aligned with the company's growth ambitions and commercial plans.
* Lead the transformation and modernization of the plant, including capacity expansion, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Translate business objectives into clear operational targets and a roadmap that the wider operations team can deliver against.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to overall business direction and decision\-making.


****Operational Excellence****
* Drive operational excellence across the facility through lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured continuous improvement programs.
* Improve key metrics including OEE, yield, throughput, labor productivity, and waste reduction, with sustained year\-on\-year gains.
* Establish robust planning and scheduling disciplines that ensure on\-time, in\-full delivery against demand.
* Lead root\-cause problem solving and a culture of data\-driven decision making across all shifts and functions.


****Production \& Facility Management****
* Own the full production operation, from raw material intake through processing, freezing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure the reliability and performance of all plant assets, including cold\-chain, freezing, and refrigeration infrastructure, through proactive and preventive maintenance.
* Oversee facility management, utilities, and capital projects to keep the plant running safely and efficiently at all times.


****Quality \& Food Safety****
* Ensure full compliance with all food safety, quality, and regulatory standards, including SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, GMP, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness at all times and uphold the highest standards of hygiene, traceability, and product integrity.
* Build quality and food safety into the culture of the plant, not just the systems.


****People \& Organization****
* Lead, develop, and inspire a large multi\-disciplinary workforce across production, quality, engineering, and supply chain.
* Build organizational capability through hiring, succession planning, training, and performance management.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement at every level.


****Financial \& Commercial****
* Own the facility's operating budget and capital plan, with full P\&L accountability for the cost of operations.
* Drive cost optimization across labor, materials, energy, and overhead without compromising quality or safety.
* Partner closely with commercial, supply chain, and procurement teams to align production with sales, inventory, and service targets.


****Candidate Profile****
* 15\+ years in food manufacturing operations, with significant experience in frozen, chilled, or processed food production.
* Proven track record at Operations Director, Plant Director, or Head of Factory level, leading a full facility at scale.
* Demonstrated success delivering operational excellence, plant transformation, and measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, and quality.
* Deep expertise in food safety and quality systems, with hands\-on command of SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, and GMP.
* Strong engineering, maintenance, and capital project experience, including cold\-chain and freezing infrastructure.
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia, including familiarity with local regulatory requirements, Saudization, and large\-workforce management.
* Engineering, food technology, or operations management degree; postgraduate qualification or lean/Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Exceptional leadership presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build and lead high\-performing teams.


****Key Competencies****
* Strategic and operational leadership
* Operational excellence and continuous improvement
* Food safety and quality governance
* Financial and commercial acumen
* People leadership and organizational development
* Results orientation and accountability
