Our client is a well\-established diversified group headquartered in Doha, Qatar, with a strong presence across multiple business sectors. As the organisation continues its growth and transformation journey, it is seeking a strategic HR leader to strengthen its people agenda, enhance organisational capability, and build a high\-performance culture across the group.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Chief Human Resources Officer will lead the group’s overall human capital strategy, aligning people initiatives with the organisation’s long\-term business objectives. The role will oversee all HR functions, including organisational development, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation and benefits, learning and development, employee engagement, succession planning, and HR operations.
   

  

 Working closely with the Group CEO and executive leadership team, the CHRO will drive organisational effectiveness, develop leadership capabilities, and ensure the business attracts, develops, and retains top talent. The role will also lead HR transformation initiatives, modernise policies and systems, strengthen governance and compliance, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all business units.
   

  

**Candidate Profile**
 Candidates should possess significant executive\-level HR leadership experience within large, diversified organisations or complex multi\-business environments. Proven expertise in developing and executing enterprise\-wide people strategies, organisational transformation, talent management, and leadership development is essential. Experience operating within the GCC, preferably Qatar, is highly desirable. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong commercial acumen, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence executive decision\-making while building a high\-performing organisational culture. A strategic mindset, executive presence, and the ability to lead change at scale are critical for success in this role.

**Purpose/ Mission:**
 The IT Manager is responsible for establishing, managing, and developing the overall Information Technology (IT) function for Meranti Green Steel Oman (MGSO). This role will lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of the company's IT infrastructure, systems, cybersecurity, applications, and digital solutions to support business operations, project development, and future plant operations in Oman.
   

  

 The IT Manager will act as the primary IT lead for the Oman business, working closely with corporate teams, external service providers, and business stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable technology solutions are in place to support the company's growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 IT Strategy \& Governance
   

  

* Develop and implement the IT roadmap and technology strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Establish IT policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, cybersecurity standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop and manage the annual IT budget and expenditure plans.


 IT Infrastructure \& Operations
   

  

* Establish and maintain all IT infrastructure for the Oman office and future operational sites.
* Manage corporate networks, internet connectivity, servers, cloud services, storage, and communication systems.
* Ensure system availability, reliability, and business continuity.
* Oversee IT asset management, software licensing, and hardware lifecycle management.


 Cybersecurity \& Risk Management
   

  

* Develop and implement cybersecurity controls and best practices.
* Monitor and manage cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, and incident response activities.
* Ensure appropriate backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans are in place.
* Lead cybersecurity awareness initiatives across the organization.


 Business Systems \& Applications
   

  

* Manage business applications and digital platforms used across the organization.
* Support implementation and administration of ERP, HR, Finance, Procurement, Document Management, and collaboration systems.
* Work closely with functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and digitalization.
* Ensure system integrations and data integrity across business applications.


 Project \& Operational Support
   

  

* Support project teams with technology requirements during project development and execution phases.
* Participate in the planning and implementation of IT systems required for future plant operations.
* Coordinate with engineering, operations, procurement, and corporate teams to deliver technology solutions supporting business growth.


 Vendor \& Contract Management

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* The Senior OU Tech Partner (UAE) is a senior Organisational Unit (OU) Digital \& Technology partner accountable for delivering business\-critical digital capabilities that enable commercial growth and operational excellence across the MEA OU.
* The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day delivery and operational management of digital and technology capabilities supporting Haleon’s OU priorities in the MEA. Acting as the primary technology partner to OU business leaders, this role ensures digital priorities are translated into reliable, scalable solutions aligned to global platforms and standards.
* The focus is on execution excellence, adoption, operational performance, and measurable business impact, rather than enterprise or regional strategy ownership.
* The role requires experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, and digital platforms, alongside operational technologies such as infrastructure and security.
* Combining strong commercial understanding with execution leadership, the Senior OU Tech Partner owns end\-to\-end delivery, adoption, and performance of digital initiatives, while ensuring alignment with Haleon’s global roadmaps, governance, and ways of working.
* Success in this role is driven by delivery excellence, business impact, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Delivery \& Execution**
* Deliver agreed digital and technology initiatives supporting OU priorities in the MEA.
* Translate defined roadmaps and plans into clear delivery activities, milestones, and outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for key OU initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes (e.g. growth, productivity, adoption).
* Coordinate and lead delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors to ensure timely execution.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues proactively.


**Business \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with OU Marketing, Sales, Customer, and Corporate teams to clarify requirements and support delivery.
* Partner with commercial leaders to align digital initiatives with market growth priorities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible business value.
* Bring strong understanding of commercial drivers (sales execution, distribution, customer engagement, eCommerce) into solution delivery.
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day technology contact for assigned domains or initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders to enable adoption and value realisation.


**Matrix \& Global Collaboration**
* Partner with global product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver MEA OU requirements in line with global standards.
* Contribute delivery feedback and local insights to support continuous improvement of global platforms and services.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure delivery activities follow secure‑by‑design principles and established architecture standards.
* Apply global IT governance, risk, and compliance frameworks within assigned scope.
* Support compliance with local regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.


**Operations \& Financial Management**
* Monitor operational performance of owned digital and technology services and support issue resolution with global teams.
* Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and benefits tracking for assigned initiatives.


**Team \& Capability Contribution**
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams and workstreams across markets, global platform teams, and vendors.
* Provide direction, prioritisation, and decision support across complex initiatives.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for delivery, adoption, and performance challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital, technology, or commercial technology roles, including leadership of complex delivery initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, CRM, or digital experience platforms.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global organisation, partnering with central product and platform teams.
* Exposure to technology operations, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to engage both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience in CPG, retail, or consumer‑led environments advantageous.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-06\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

* Implement and monitor cybersecurity controls across OT environments, including network segregation, access control, and threat detection, aligned with QTECH cybersecurity standards.
* Coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security audits for city infrastructure.
* Ensure compliance with national cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NCA) and internal Qiddiya policies.
* Transition, Handover \& Acceptance
* Act as the primary City Operations IT authority for the acceptance and handover of network and security infrastructure from QTECH, MDU, and District Master Developers.
* Define operational readiness criteria, testing protocols, and documentation standards for onboarding new assets.
* Participate in design reviews to ensure operational, maintainability, and security requirements are embedded early in the lifecycle.

* Manage relationships and operational contracts with neutral hosts, data center operators, and managed service providers.
* Collaborate closely with QTECH Design teams to ensure alignment on architecture, shared services, and governance frameworks.

* Proven track record in managing large\-scale, mission\-critical infrastructure within complex environments such as smart cities, giga\-projects, utilities, or industrial sectors.
* Extensive experience bridging IT and OT environments, with a strong understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, and IoT network architectures.

**Technical Skills \& Certifications**

* Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
* Experience with physical security network infrastructure, including CCTV, VMS, and ACS systems.

+ Security: CISSP, CISM, GICSP, or equivalent.
+ Service Management: ITIL v4\.


****Core Competencies****
* Strategic thinker with strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams and executive leadership.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-paced, and evolving environments.
* Strong vendor management and contract negotiation expertise

 The CAIO will oversee the development of the Group AI roadmap, evaluate enterprise AI technologies, establish governance policies, manage strategic partnerships with AI technology providers, and ensure that all AI initiatives align with the Group’s strategic objectives and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Beyond technology, the CAIO will champion organisational change by promoting AI literacy, fostering responsible AI adoption, and building an innovation culture that enables every business to leverage AI effectively.
   

  

 The role carries enterprise\-wide accountability for AI strategy, investment prioritisation, governance, and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Candidate Profile**
 Candidates should possess extensive executive leadership experience in Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Technology, Innovation, or Strategy within large and complex organisations.
   

  

 Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes, developing AI or digital strategies, and engaging with C\-suite stakeholders is essential. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong commercial judgement, exceptional stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate emerging technologies into practical business value.
   

  

 Experience working within diversified groups or multi\-business environments across the GCC will be considered highly advantageous.

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous l'autorité de la Conseillère de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) / Directrice de l'Institut français du Koweït (IFK) et en lien avec l’agence comptable régionale (ACR) et le secrétariat général d'ambassade (SGA), vous occupez les fonctions de secrétaire général (SG) d’un établissement à autonomie financière (EAF) en organisant le fonctionnement et la gestion administrative, matérielle, juridique, budgétaire et financière de l’Institut Français du Koweït qui dispose d’une personnalité juridique locale. Vous gérez également les crédits du service de coopération et d'action culturelle (SCAC) et proposez un appui ponctuel à l’Institut français de recherche à l’étranger, le Centre français de Recherche de la péninsule arabique à Koweït (CEFREPA).
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 Sous l'autorité du COCAC/Directeur, vous êtes responsable des affaires générales, des questions budgétaires, comptables et administratives, du management des ressources humaines, de la gestion immobilière, logistique, matérielle et de la sécurité. Vos missions principales sont les suivantes : 1\. Contribution au pilotage : \- mise en œuvre du plan de redynamisation de l’activité et de redressement financier de l’institut ; \- présentation des résultats et performances ; \- réalisation d'études de rentabilité et analyses prospectives ; \- accompagnement du directeur dans sa politique de mécénat et sponsoring ; \- réflexion sur les trajectoire financière, rationalisation des moyens et diversification des ressources. 2\. Gestion financière et budgétaire : \- préparation et exécution du budget, élaboration des budgets rectificatifs, mise en place d’outils d’optimisation de gestion, analyse des comptes budgétaires et suivi des tableaux de bord ; \- interface avec le ministère (DGM/DDC/RES, tutelle de l'IF) pour le contrôle de gestion et le rapport d’activités ; \- suivi du Contrôle interne financier (CIF) avec l'ACR. Le SG est membre du comité de gouvernance. 3\. Gestion des ressources humaines : \- coordination et encadrement des personnels, suivi de l’organigramme fonctionnel (ADL, expatriés), plannings, congés ; \- gestion administrative des personnels (recrutement, déroulement de carrière, contrats, évaluation, ...) ; \- suivi, application de la législation locale du travail, en lien avec l’avocat conseil du poste ; \- animation du dialogue social, relations avec les représentants du personnel et délégués syndicaux, gestion des conflits ; \- mise en place de formations ; \- suivi des questions d'hygiène, de sécurité et de conditions de travail. 4\. Gestion administrative : \- pilotage administratif et juridique (contrôle des conventions, veille juridique, gestion du contentieux ; \- suivi des contrats et conventions signés par chaque antenne, supervision des procédures administratives ; \- rédaction des notes de service, rappel des instructions, coordination des moyens et des ressources, conventions de prestation, contrat de location des locaux, rédaction de contrats avec les artistes, gestion et accueil des artistes en tournée, contact avec les fournisseurs) ; \- contrôle des activités de l'ensemble des services : réorganisation des procédures, limitation du risque de vol/fraude (en particulier au niveau du centre de langues, de l'espace Campus France, de la médiathèque) ; \- mise à jour du guide d’accueil, du règlement intérieur ; \- suivi de l'inventaire et de l'archivage. 5\. Gestion logistique, matérielle et immobilière : \- gestion du bâti et de l'investissement (travaux et commande) ; \- veille à la mise à jour régulière du plan de sécurité des emprises ; \- relations avec le propriétaire ; \- négociation et suivi des contrats de maintenance ; \- gestion des risques et veille à l'application des consignes de sécurité ; \- mise à jour du règlement intérieur de sécurité.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Pour les agents du MEAE : BAACA option encadrement. Connaissance indispensable de la DGM, de son organisation, de ses procédures, de ses outils et mécanismes de financement. Expérience réussie dans des fonctions similaires au sein d’un Institut Français, notamment en management, ainsi qu'en suivi budgétaire/gestion des ressources humaines d’un établissement cultuel. Sans être indispensable, de même que la connaissance de la région, la maîtrise de la langue locale constituerait un atout.

**Classification:** 
 Executive / Academic Leadership

 Vice President for Academic Affairs (VPAA)
 



  





**About The American International University** 




 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, and Business Administration, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
 



  





 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
 



  





**School of Engineering Profile** 




 The School of Engineering and \& Computing at the American International University in Kuwait comprises the departments of Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. The School offers Bachelor of Science (BSc) degrees in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
 



  





 The School is committed to providing excellence in education through highly qualified faculty members with extensive backgrounds and experience.”
 



  





**Scope of Work** 




 The Dean of the School of Engineering \& Computing provides strategic, academic, and administrative leadership to advance AIU’s engineering programs. The Dean oversees academic quality, faculty development, accreditation, research and innovation, and operational effectiveness, fostering excellence, continuous improvement, and sustainable growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide overall leadership and management for the School of Engineering, including oversight of full\-time and adjunct faculty, academic programs, and administrative operations.
* Oversee all engineering and computing degree programs, including Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
* Lead curriculum development, course scheduling, program assessment, and continuous improvement of degree offerings to ensure academic excellence and market relevance.
* Manage the School’s budget, resource allocation, and strategic planning.
* Drive faculty recruitment, mentoring, performance review, and professional development.
* Promote a culture of research and scholarship across the School; support faculty and student research activities.
* Maintain and engage the Industry Advisory Committee to align programs with industry needs and employer expectations.
* Lead and coordinate accreditation efforts and quality assurance activities (institutional and programmatic), including familiarity with ABET and other relevant accreditation frameworks.
* Ensure the School’s website and public communications accurately reflect programs, achievements, and student opportunities.
* Foster industry and community partnerships, internships, and experiential learning opportunities for students.
* Represent the School in university leadership meetings and contribute to institution\-wide strategic initiatives.
* Support infrastructure development, laboratory enhancements, and academic resources.
* Engage with industry partners and advisory boards to drive applied research and external collaboration.
* Oversee program review, learning outcomes assessment, and academic quality assurance.
* Promote student success, retention, progression, and graduate employability through data\-informed academic leadership.



  





**Reporting Departments (If Applicable)** 



* Faculty in the School of Engineering
* Administrative and program support staff



  





**Minimum Qualifications:** 




 The ideal candidate shall demonstrate experience in professional and academic positions, as well as a strong record in teaching and outstanding academic achievements at the international level. The candidate is expected to demonstrate ongoing contributions in their field of specialization through published research in recognized international scientific journals, as well as participation in exhibitions, conferences, and symposiums, in addition to possessing the following degrees, qualifications, and professional experience:
 



  




* Ph.D. or equivalent from a recognized university.
* The rank of professor in one of the School's disciplines.
* A record of excellence in teaching and research appropriate to the rank of professor in one of the School's disciplines.
* Leadership qualities and proven research background in one of the School's disciplines.
* A clear vision for developing higher education in general and for the School in particular.
* Full familiarity with the credit hour and academic year (semester) system.
* Distinguished managerial experience in the affairs of higher education, preferably at the level of a college dean in a reputable university.
* Experience with the standards of program accreditation by specialized commissions at national education institutions.
* Acumen in the area of human resources and administrative and financial concepts, practices, policies, and procedures.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with large sectors of a diverse community.
* Experience in communicating with universities, professional and academic institutions, associations, unions, companies and business administration institutions, and other institutions within the field of education and research.
* Bi\-lingual proficiency in English and Arabic (spoken and written) is a plus.
* Experience working within American, American\-style, or internationally accredited higher education systems is preferred.



  





**Additional Qualifications** 




**Priority will be given to applicants with the following qualifications:** 



* Managerial experience and the skills necessary to launch pioneering projects.
* Multi\-cultural skills.
* Active participation in reputable organizations.
* Knowledge of the methods of evaluation and related matters.
* Documentation demonstrating support for the achievements of teachers and students.
* Understanding of the latest teaching methods, including the use of technology in the teaching process.
* Demonstration of a commitment to enriching the educational experience of students.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
 



  





 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The successful candidate is expected to commence employment on August 30, 2026\.

 This role covers corporate IT only. Production technology systems sit separately with the technology leadership team
 **.**

* Procurement, configuration, and lifecycle management of laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices; maintaining the device inventory and asset register
* Administering the productivity suite (M365 or equivalent) including mailboxes, file storage, collaboration tools, and licensing
* Identity and access management: account provisioning, role\-based access, multi\-factor authentication, and the joiner\-mover\-leaver process
* First\-line IT support for staff: incident triage, resolution, and escalation to the outsourced managed service provider where needed
* Applying cybersecurity policy to corporate systems: email security, endpoint protection, patching, and security awareness training
* Managing corporate IT vendor relationships, service contracts, and the IT contract register



  





  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least five years in an IT operations, IT administration, or end\-user computing role. Demonstrated experience administering M365 or equivalent productivity suites. Working knowledge of identity management, MDM, and endpoint security. Fluent in English; working Arabic preferred. Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent certifications are an advantage. So is familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001\) and prior experience in a small\-firm or regulated environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a founding\-team role. The corporate IT environment is being built now, and the person in this role will set it up properly from the start. If you are self\-sufficient, security\-conscious, and want to own your environment rather than operate within one someone else built, this is worth a conversation.

 **ERP Applications Lead**

* Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate

 The ideal candidate should be able to work closely with business users, implementation partners, technical teams, and senior stakeholders to support successful ERP delivery and continuous system improvement.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for leading the Country Audit team, and managing the provision of internal audit and related advisory services for the Branch’s activities. In this regard, the incumbent will develop the annual internal audit plan for the Branch for review by Group Internal Audit Division and subsequently ensure the timely implementation/ execution of the plan in line with applicable best practices, including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA).
   

  

 The responsibility includes also the follow\-up of issues raised by Group Internal Audit Division and preparation of status reports, review of Policies and Procedures and conduct investigations/special assignments as and when requested. The role will also extend to the secondary responsibilities assigned to the incumbent in terms of specific audit activities/ functions/ departments and special projects, as assigned by his superiors, in addition to his primary responsibility. The position requires sufficient expertise and knowledge to focus/ monitor a wide range of risks in their countries business.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Ensure effectiveness of adopted policies/ procedures adherence to regulatory and statutory requirements, and safeguarding of the Branch’s assets.
* Add value to the functions/ activities performed by the Branch by identifying instances/ risks that could result in financial losses or regulatory non\-compliance, monetary penalties/ reputation damage through the audit and risk review process.
* Identify potential cost saving opportunities by highlighting process inefficiencies through the above processes.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for the internal audit function and its roles.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated by the GIAD to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure adequate coverage of the Branch’s activities in the annual audit plan to provide assurance to the relevant executive management on the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal controls in place within the respective department/ function and add value to improve the functioning of the various activities performed by the referenced department/ function, as and where applicable.
* Act as primary Internal Audit subject matter expert in country, in order to ensure adherence to the full range of regulatory requirements (both local and Qatar regulators) including QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures Financial Crime Risk, ESG, Fraud Risk Management, Regulatory reporting and Information Security etc.
* Provide timely feedback/ information to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on queries, reports and other correspondence received by Branch Management either directly from the external auditors or the applicable regulators in the respective jurisdictions, to enable the latter to respond to the same in a timely and efficient manner, that pertain to the incumbent’s area of responsibility.
* Execute and/or support in completion of any requirement, tasks or requests from local regulator or GIAD’s office specifically related to Internal Audit, including reviews of regulatory returns, and periodic certifications.
* Liaise with the relevant officials from Country Regulators as and when required and provide clarifications/ responses to queries/ reports/ other correspondence received.
* Liaise with the external auditors of the branch to ensure that they complement the efforts of the Internal Audit and avoid duplication of effort. This will involve meetings with the external auditors to discuss the planned audit work, the exchange of working papers, audit reports and management letters, and to ensure common understanding of audit techniques, methods and terminology.
* Manage the relationships with the Branch’s executive management and obtain their inputs/ concerns on the various functions/ activities pertaining to the Branch including significant developments therein, which could have an impact on the annual audit plan for the Branch.
* Support Internal Audit teams of other QNB international entities, as and where requested by GIAD.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Conduct a risk assessment for branch individual functions/ processes/ products and related procedures on at least annual basis as an input to annual audit planning exercise.
* Prepare an annual audit for submission to the VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/comments and approval, based on the risk assessment conducted for the Branch and in line with its overall strategy.
* Ensure timely implementation and execution of the approved annual audit plan. Also responsible for submitting periodic status reports on the progress to VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and explaining the reasons for the delay in completion of individual assignments, if applicable.
* Ensure the continued adherence to internal auditing best practices including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA) recommendations/guidelines. Ensure that the audit planning, fieldwork and reporting stages are conducted in consonance with the procedures/ guidelines contained in the internal audit manual. Also, make recommendations to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on any improvements to the approved internal audit manual, in line with best practices.
* Escalate promptly (on interim basis if required) any major issues/ significant concerns emerging from the areas/ functions audited, to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/ action to enable timely rectification/ resolution of the highlighted issues.
* Utilize appropriate audit management application software procured by GIAD
* Ensure effective audit follow\-up process in order to monitor and report on status of issues raised in reports issued by Internal Audit, External auditors and regulators.
* Submit performance appraisals to the VP \-International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on timely basis in accordance with the laid down policy in this regard.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external auditors, regulators and the Compliance function as and when required.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify related areas for professional development based on discussions with the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and ensure they are part of their development plan.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank and attain/maintain the required levels of competence.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and the team’s overall performance on a regular basis.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Legal, Regulatory and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, the QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (Anti Money Laundering \& Counter Terrorist Financing, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify, measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Carry out all other ad hoc tasks, duties and/or activities that GIAD may request from time to time.
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate (Bachelor’s degree) preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, Accounting (or related field of study), Masters preferred
* Minimum of 12 years’ experience in a major bank or leading audit firm out of which 5 years in a managerial role with a major bank.
* Professional Audit qualifications such as CIA / CMA / CPA / CA/ ACCA / CISA or equivalent is required.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.

* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.

data.jd_text:
**About Rateb** 




 Rateb is a digital wallet built to make everyday payments simple, secure, and transparent in Kuwait. Employers and payers send salaries, advances, and dues digitally; recipients receive, manage, withdraw, and transfer their money with ease — replacing cash and paper receipts with secure digital records.
 



 We're launching with domestic workers and their employers — a community of hundreds of thousands that today runs almost entirely on cash. It's a focused first market, not the limit of the ambition: the same wallet, payments, and partner infrastructure are built to extend to a far wider set of users and payment needs across Kuwait.
 



  





 Designed for Kuwait's diverse population — with multi\-language support built into the product roadmap — Rateb integrates with exchange companies for transfers and banking channels for cash withdrawal.
 



  





**The Role — Head of Marketing** 




 You will own how Rateb goes to market — building the brand from launch and driving the acquisition of both employers and the workers they pay. This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Kuwait City, working closely with product, operations, and leadership to turn a new platform into a recognised, trusted name.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Own the go\-to\-market strategy and lead Rateb's launch into its first market
* Build the brand and positioning from the ground up, across two distinct audiences — employers and beneficiaries
* Plan and run multi\-channel acquisition campaigns, owning the budget and the targets
* Define the metrics that matter — cost per acquisition, activation, retention — and manage performance against them
* Manage agency and partner relationships, and brief external creative and media support
* Develop messaging that works across Kuwait's diverse, multi\-language population
* Work with product and operations to align the customer journey from first touch to active use
* Report marketing performance and spend to senior leadership



**What you'll bring** 



* Proven marketing leadership, ideally in fintech, payments, telco, or consumer services
* A track record taking a product to market — launch experience, not just steady\-state brand management
* Strong command of performance marketing and the economics behind it: CAC, funnel, retention
* Experience marketing to underserved or hard\-to\-reach audiences a real plus
* Familiarity with Kuwait's market and media landscape
* Fluency in English and Arabic

 :
 



 Sales Strategy \& Revenue Growth
 


* Develop and implement the airline's sales strategy aligned with corporate and commercial objectives.
* Deliver revenue, market share, yield, and passenger volume targets across all markets.
* Identify new business opportunities, customer segments, and revenue streams.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to optimize sales initiatives.
* Support route launches and network expansion through targeted sales and market development plans.



 Corporate \& Trade Sales Management
 


* Develop and manage relationships with corporate accounts, travel management companies (TMCs), travel agencies, online travel agencies (OTAs), tour operators, and government entities.
* Negotiate commercial agreements, incentive programs, and preferred partnerships.
* Drive growth in high\-yield corporate and SME segments.

 Distribution \& Channel Management

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.

* Prepare regular management reports, sales dashboards, and performance reviews.
* Ensure accurate forecasting and achievement of revenue objectives.



 Stakeholder Management
 


* Work closely with Revenue Management, Network Planning, Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, and Operations teams.
* Represent Jazeera Airways at industry forums, trade exhibitions, and key customer meetings.
* Build strategic partnerships that strengthen the airline's market position and commercial performance.

 What you'll do: Elicit what entities really need, map the processes, and turn it into clear, build ready requirements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

 Elicit, analyze, and document requirements from many government entities and stakeholders
   

 Map current state and future state processes, and model them clearly, for example in BPMN
   

 Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
   

 Facilitate workshops, and resolve conflicting requirements into one coherent picture
   

 Run gap, impact, and feasibility analysis, and surface risks and dependencies early
   

 Maintain requirements traceability from need through to delivered feature
   

 Partner with product, architecture, and engineering, and support user acceptance testing
   

 Validate that delivered solutions actually meet the requirements, and close the loop
   

  

 What makes you a fit:
   

 You have been the senior business analyst on complex software, and your specs got built
   

 You are excellent at elicitation and facilitation, and you draw out what stakeholders actually need
   

 You model and map processes clearly, and you write crisp, unambiguous requirements
   

 You bridge business and engineering, and both sides trust your translation
   

 You turn conflicting, messy demands into one ordered, agreed picture
   

 You hold a Bachelor's or higher in a relevant field; business analysis certifications are a plus
   

 You are rigorous about traceability, and nothing important falls through the cracks
   

 Bonus points for government, public sector, or regulated process work
   

 Fluent English required; Arabic is a valuable advantage
   

  

 If you turn government complexity into requirements teams can build, do it here. Apply.

**Overview** 




 Amana Healthcare, brought to you by M42 and Mumtalakat, is pleased to announce the first Amana Healthcare facility in Bahrain, located in Al Jasra. This world\-class hospital will provide long\-term care and post\-acute rehabilitation services.
 



  





 M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting\-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient\-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The Nurse Manager is responsible for leading, supervising, and coordinating nursing services in the long\-term care hospital to ensure safe, high\-quality, and patient\-centered care. The role involves clinical leadership, staff management, compliance with NHRA regulations, and continuous improvement of nursing practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Clinical \& Operational Management** 



* Oversee daily nursing operations across wards/units in the long\-term care facility.
* Ensure delivery of high\-quality, safe, and evidence\-based nursing care.
* Monitor patient outcomes, quality indicators, and incident reports; initiate corrective actions where required.
* Ensure proper patient assessment, care planning, implementation, and evaluation.
* Coordinate with physicians, allied health professionals, and support services to ensure continuity of care.



**Staff Management \& Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and supervise nursing staff including Charge Nurses, Registered Nurses, and HCAs.
* Prepare duty rosters, manage staffing levels, and ensure optimal skill mix.
* Conduct staff performance appraisals, competency assessments, and probation evaluations.
* Identify training needs and support ongoing professional development of nursing staff.
* Promote a positive, ethical, and professional work environment.



**Quality, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with NHRA standards, hospital policies, and Bahrain labor laws.
* Participate in audits, inspections, and accreditation activities.
* Implement infection control practices and patient safety initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation and adherence to nursing standards of practice.



**Policy \& Process Improvement** 



* Develop, review, and implement nursing policies, SOPs, and clinical guidelines.
* Participate in quality improvement projects and clinical governance activities.
* Support change management initiatives within nursing services.



**Administrative Responsibilities** 



* Assist in budgeting, resource planning, and cost control within the nursing department.
* Monitor utilization of supplies, equipment, and medications.
* Prepare reports for senior management as required.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (Master’s Degree preferred).
* Valid NHRA nursing license (or eligibility to obtain).
* Minimum
 **8–10 years of nursing experience** 
 , with
 **3–5 years in a leadership/managerial role** 
 .
* Prior experience in
 **Long Term Care, Rehabilitation, Geriatric, or Chronic Care settings** 
 is highly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of NHRA standards and healthcare regulations in Bahrain.

**Job Description**
 We’re looking for a Senior Operations Manager to join the team and focus on growing our own
   

  

 Grocery Store “tMart”, which is the region’s first cloud store concept offering 30\-minutedelivery of
   

  

 groceries at hypermarket prices. The service has expanded rapidly across Kuwait, UAE, Qatar, Jordan,
   

  

 Bahrain, Egypt, Oman and Iraq!
   

  

* Managing the full operations end to end (team operations, inventory management,


 pick\-pack process, property/asset management, operational standards, expense
   

  

 control, maintenance related).
   

  

* Inventory management: Ensure correct processes, policies and proper execution of


 inventory management (stock\-in and stock\-out). Shrink/Expiry control and Quality
   

  

 focus (in terms of inventory no damaged or poor fresh food quality; close to expiry).
   

  

* Pick\-Pack process: Ensure efficient and correct pick and pack process and service


 level (starting with ensuring availability, picking up the correct item/quantity) \& proper
   

  

 management of the staffing and scheduling as per demand to achieve desired UTR
   

  

 and service level.
   

  

* Property / Asset management: Proper management of the property and facility, plus


 asset management and tracking.
   

  

* Expense Control: Identify potential opportunities to reduce expenses with same


 operational efficiency.
   

  

* Maintenance related: Define the guidelines for all engineering and maintenance tasks /


 equipment / key activities i.e. outsourcing VS internal services, local VS regional
   

  

 contracts, preventive maintenance plan, etc.
   

  

* Managing Productivity, work standards, and development of store staff.
* Monitoring and managing the store costs VS budget for the section.
* Ensuring continuous improvement of current performance VS accepted standard/best


 practices at the store (i.e. stock level, productivity, service level).
   

  

* Monitoring financial and operational performance of each store and initiating required


 actions for improvement.
   

  

* Controlling and ensuring that equipment, infrastructure, etc. in stores are used and


 maintained properly.
   

  

* Developing action plans with the department manager to address weak areas in need


 of improvement.
   

  

* Instituting training and developmental programs for staff and monitoring effective


 implementation.
   

  

* Monitoring product range availability according to selected store product range.
* Develop preventive and regular maintenance plans.


**WHAT DID WE ORDER?**
* You have at least 10\+ years of experience in progressive development and management of


 multiple product categories, matured by working for large retailers, in an international setting.
   

  

 If you have worked for a fulfilment, e\-commerce, FMCG retail business it is a plus.
   

  

* You have built teams and led cross\-functional projects at scale.
* You are very detail\-oriented, structured and know how to prioritize \-\- you consider yourself


 as someone who delivers solutions and not bottlenecks to be solved.
   

  

* You are able to interact with senior\-level executives and can manage the expectations of


 multiple stakeholders.
   

  

* You are someone energized by the unknown and look forward to learning each day on the job.
* You have excellent analytical and communication skills, and always like to be hands\-on with


 several tools.
   

  

* Additionally, you have robust interpersonal and intercultural skills. You can inspire several


 teams and stakeholders to rally behind a mission.
